jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product (m/f/d) | Berlin | Full-Time

Location:  Berlin, Germany (office first)
 Start date:  As soon as possible
 Company:  Venture-backed AI startup, early stage

About the Company

We’re a fast-growing AI company building agents for complex, high-stakes enterprise workflows in public procurement, one of Europe’s largest and least digitised markets. Our product takes on the slow, manual, document-heavy work behind public tenders. That saves businesses and the public sector a great deal of wasted time and money.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product to own and scale our product function. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll be the most senior product person in the company and work directly with the founders and engineering team. You’ll personally drive discovery, prioritisation and delivery. As we grow, you’ll set up how the product function works: its processes, rituals and culture. When the time is right, you’ll hire the team around you.

What You’ll Do

Own the product strategy and roadmap, setting direction alongside the founders, engineering and customers.  Lead core product initiatives end to end, from discovery and scoping through launch and iteration. You’ll ship AI products that enterprise customers rely on.  Stay close to the product: test, refine and pressure-test our agents, and understand how prompts, context and evaluations shape quality.  Spend real time with customers. Uncover requirements, turn noisy feedback into clear priorities and become a trusted partner to their business.  Build the product function. Define how we discover, prioritise, ship and measure, and lay the foundations for a future product team.  Work with GTM on positioning and join sales conversations where product insight wins deals.

Who You Are

5+ years in product management or a closely related role (founder, early operator, consulting into product), with a strong record of shipping.  A startup operator at heart. You’ve done your best work at early-stage companies, ideally as one of the first product hires or as a founder. Experience only at large corporates won’t be the right fit for this role.  A strong all-rounder, as comfortable setting strategy as writing a detailed spec, debugging an edge case or jumping on a sales call.  Exceptional product sense and user empathy. You look past the surface of a feature request to find the root problem.  Technically curious. You don’t need a CS degree or coding skills, but you’re confident working with engineers and exploring what AI can and can’t do.  A clear communicator who uses both qualitative and quantitative reasoning to make and explain decisions.  Based in Berlin or ready to relocate.  Fluent in English and German (required for our customer base).  Nice to have: B2B or enterprise software experience (strongly preferred), hands-on work with AI/LLM products, or exposure to public sector or regulated markets.

You’ll Thrive If

You love building from 0 to 1. You don’t need a roadmap

Wir sind Klickkonzept. Eine datengetriebene, KI-orientierte Online-Marketing-Agentur im Herzen von Frankfurt. Echte Leidenschaft, eine offene Kultur und die Überzeugung, dass jeder Einzelne bei uns Großes bewirken kann.

Du stehst am Anfang deiner Karriere im digitalen Marketing und hast keine Lust auf Kaffee kochen oder monotone Dateneingabe? Du willst tief in die Mechanik von Google, Amazon, Meta & Co. eintauchen und verstehen, wie Unternehmen heute online wirklich Geld verdienen – von der Suchanzeige über den Social Feed bis zum KI-Chatbot, der Kaufentscheidungen prägt? Dann bist du hier genau richtig.

Unser Versprechen: Vom Anfänger zum Strategie-Designer

Wir suchen keine fertigen Experten. Wir suchen smarte, analytische Köpfe mit dem unbedingten Willen zu lernen. In unserem Trainee-Programm bilden wir dich zum sogenannten „T-Shaped Marketer" aus. Was das heißt? Gemeinsam wählen wir deinen vertikalen Schwerpunkt – deine Spezialdisziplin, in der du echte Tiefe aufbaust:

Paid Search (SEA) - bezahlte Sichtbarkeit in Google & Co.

Paid Social - Performance-Kampagnen auf Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn & Co.

Amazon Ads / Retail Media - Werbung dort, wo gekauft wird

SEO & GEO - organische Sichtbarkeit in klassischen Suchmaschinen und in KI-Antwortsystemen wie ChatGPT, Gemini oder Google AI Overviews

Das ist der vertikale Strich im „T". Gleichzeitig bringen wir dir bei, wie das gesamte digitale Marketing-Ökosystem zusammenspielt (der horizontale Strich) – denn die spannendsten Ergebnisse entstehen genau dort, wo die Kanäle ineinandergreifen. Du lernst nicht nur, wie man Knöpfe in Werbekonten oder Tools drückt. jobs.title: Social Creative
jobs.description:
Intro

Wil jij als creative deel uitmaken van een snel groeiend en tech gedreven creatief advertising & content bureau in de Houthavens en samen met een leuk team werk maken dat opvalt, werkt én connact? ACT. Now!

Advertising, Content en Technology, samen met jou

ACT.agency staat voor Advertising, Content & Technology together. Wij geloven dat advertising en content via een geïntegreerde aanpak ontwikkeld moet worden, versnelt door technology. Met onze ACT.vertising aanpak zorgen we ervoor dat merken zich strategisch en creatief onderscheiden, always-on communiceren en zo consistent blijven op de lange én korte termijn. In ons kantoor in de Amsterdamse Houthavens werken we met 32 mensen aan accounts als Odido, PwC, Mercedes-Benz Trucks, Schiphol, Museumkaart, Noordhoff en Prinses Máxima Centrum.  ACT zoekt een medior Social Creative. Of ben je juist een medior creatief met veel social ervaring? Allebei kan. Want dat is ook precies waar wij ons als ACT begeven: tussen advertising en content, met veel social werk. Je bedenkt alleen of samen in een team het concept, schrijft het uit en maakt het zelf, snel en met de nieuwste technologie.  Taken  Als creative bij ACT bedenk je concepten die kloppen, de kern raken en waar iedereen energie van krijgt. Social is jouw vak: ongeveer 80% van je werk. De rest is breder creatief werk, zoals campagne-ideeën en pitches.  Je schrijft het script, pakt zelfs eventueel de camera en kan het ook zelf monteren. Van idee tot eindresultaat is het van jou. Je idee staat als t moet als eerste versie binnen een dag. Je weet wat er speelt op Insta, TikTok en YouTube Shorts.  Je presenteert je ideeën intern en bij de klant, onderbouwt ze op basis van de briefing en denkt tactisch mee, met gelaagdheid in je campagnes. Je spart dagelijks met de creative directors en werkt samen met strategie, account, social media manegers en community management.  Wij vragen

Je hebt minimaal 2 tot 3 jaar ervaring als creative bij een creatief bureau, met veel social ervaring

Je hebt een portfolio met werk dat je zelf hebt bedacht én gemaakt, met aantoonbare resultaten

Je kunt idealiter zelf filmen en monteren, bijvoorbeeld in Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut of DaVinci

Je maakt zelf content en brengt een idee in korte tijd van concept naar een eerste versie

Je bent nieuwsgierig naar technologie en gebruikt AI-tools in je dagelijkse werk, bijvoorbeeld voor beeld, video, geluid of tekst.

Je schrijft soepele social en short copy

Je bent een nieuwsgierige, sterke persoonlijkheid met humor en energie, die goed kan samenwerken maar ook goed alleen kan werken

Je weet wat er speelt in het vak en je ideeën plus tone-of-voice zijn van deze tijd

Je hebt smaak, oog voor detail en werkt gestructureerd en nauwkeurig

Je werkt het liefst samen met je team op kantoor. Dit is geen hybride functie!

Wat we bieden

Een ambitieus bureau waar goed werk en samenwerken centraal staan

Een klantportfolio dat je elke dag uitdaagt om je talent te laten

About the role

Hi, my name is Nick Guardino, Senior Director of Marketing Ops at  Customer.io , and I'm looking for a GTM AI Engineer to help take our AI agents from scrappy prototypes to production-grade systems our GTM teams can depend on.

Over the last 3.5 months, our GTM AI team has built 11 agents now running in production, serving 120 active users and roughly 25,000 tool calls a day — all through custom CLIs that work, but weren't built to scale. We believe businesses can run leaner and go further when they deploy AI agents well, and we're figuring out that motion in real time. This role owns the scale and reliability layer so the rest of the team can keep building.

What we value

Craft over quick wins  — energized by making things robust, not just making them work.

A point of view  — we want someone who asks "why did you build it that way?" and has a specific answer for what to do instead.

Comfortable being wrong  — you try things fast, and you course-correct just as fast.

AI-native by default  — you'd rather direct Claude to write and QA code than write it by hand.

What you'll do

Alpha-to-production ownership  — take newly built agents from working v1 to production-ready: write evals, harden prompts and tool definitions, and refactor prototype scaffolding into clean, production-quality code.

Observability & stability  — instrument tracing, logging, and monitoring across the agent fleet so we catch regressions before our 120+ GTM users do.

Deployment & infrastructure  — stand up and maintain the pipelines that get agents into users' hands without surprises, owning environment parity and release hygiene on our GCP stack.

Database administration  — own how agents read from and write to our databases, safely and at scale.

Partner closely with the GTM AI team  — free up our agent builders to stay in their zero-to-one wheelhouse while you own scale and reliability.

Bring an outside point of view  — tell us what we built wrong, and back it up with a plan to fix it.

About us:

Airtm  is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive.

The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals.

Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market.

As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.

We're looking for a Head of Security to build and lead security at Airtm, reporting to the VP of Engineering. You'll own the security posture of the systems that move people's money across borders, from application code and cloud infrastructure to identity, vendors, and incident response. You'll set the strategy, build the team and the practices around it, and stay hands-on enough to make the hard technical calls yourself.

jobs.description:
About OLIX

AI is growing faster than any technology in history and the explosion in demand has created a massive infrastructure gap; we can no longer build chips or power stations fast enough to keep up. The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. You will work closely with our development team in London to establish high-throughput, high-yield manufacturing processes, then transfer those processes to our manufacturing partners and support them through ramp. The role involves extensive travel (up to 50% of the time), including to our manufacturing partner sites.

Establish and qualify robust, high-throughput, high-yield manufacturing lines for our optical interconnect technology

Specify, commission and qualify production equipment

Improve process capability through statistical process control

Represent OLIX to the management, engineering and production teams at our manufacturing partners

Collaborate across R&D, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Characterisation & Test and Production, within OLIX and at our partners, to hit project milestones

Contribute to strategic IP development and patents

Ensure compliance with site and factory protocols and safety regulations

Experience working in controlled or cleanroom environments

Proven track record of designing DoEs and executing structured experiments

Experience applying statistical process control, yield improvement and throughput optimisation in production

Ability to interpret complex experimental data, troubleshoot process issues and drive systematic improvements

Own contributor experience and retention: onboarding, payments landing on time, support, and why people stop.

Partner with the platform team on the tooling that makes supply self-serve

In 2009, Riot released its debut title, League of Legends, to critical and player acclaim. Players form the foundation of our community, and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

jobs.description:
Brief info about Vinted

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

Information about the position

The Buyer domain's Data Science teams build and iterate on our most critical ML systems—like ranking, retrieval, and recommendations—that serve millions of users. As our ambition and the complexity of these models grow, we are scaling our MLOps capabilities to match:

We are hiring an MLOps Engineer to solve this. This is a high-impact "bridge" role, not to build new platforms, but to be the expert user of our existing platforms (GCP/Vertex AI, Vespa, Triton). Your mission is to take our Data Science team's work, rectify the current ad-hoc solutions, and build the robust, automated, and high-quality "path-to-production" our advanced models require.

Also by joining Vinted, you’ll become part of an active community of engineers who are keen on sharing knowledge, organizing learning workshops and so much more!

In this position, you’ll

  • Productionise ML models: be responsible for migrating all existing model training code from experimental or proof-of-concept stages to robust and automated pipelines.

jobs.title: Senior Stack Scientist
jobs.description:
Senior Stack Scientist

About EH Energy Engineering

EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.  As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities

Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

Set the operating windows, conditioning and break-in procedures, and the diagnostic methods used in development and production.

Translate results into clear requirements for flow fields, bipolar plates, MEAs, sealing and compression.

Mentor junior scientists and engineers, and present results to internal stakeholders and partners.

Skills and Experience Required

PhD or MSc in electrochemistry, chemical engineering, mechanical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field.

12+ years of experience in fuel cell stack development or testing (PEM preferred).

Strong grasp of stack physics: water and heat management, reactant distribution, contact resistance and compression.

Hands-on experience with stack test benches, cell voltage monitoring, EIS and durability/AST protocols.

Solid understanding of MEA, GDL and bipolar plate degradation mechanisms.

Experience with modelling and data analysis tools (e.g. Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or similar).

Ability to turn complex data into clear, actionable recommendations.

Team player who can also work autonomously in a fast-moving environment.

Management experience

English is mandatory; French or German is a plus.

Start date: Immediately

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.  Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.  Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

Build the machine that builds the machine . Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them.

Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology . Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook,  every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology.

Do work that matters, and see it grow . The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world.

Make an impact you can point to . In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck.

YOUR IMPACT

You keep Alpha's cost and schedule baselines honest against each other. Without a credible risk register and change process, changes slip into the program outside any controlled path, the IMS and cost forecast quietly drift apart, and a gate review surprises leadership with numbers nobody signed off on. Your job is to prevent that by making risk and change management a live, trusted function from the earliest stage of delivery, rather than something bolted on once problems have compounded.

Establish and maintain the Alpha risk register across infrastructure, manufacturing and machine workstreams, facilitating structured risk identification, assessment and assignment of mitigation owners

jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Wil jij jouw engineering skills inzetten om AI-services te bouwen die échte klantwaarde leveren? Ben je een strategische visionair met een passie voor LLMOps, bezit je ijzersterke architecturale vaardigheden en wil je het technische anker zijn van onze AI-praktijk? En neem je graag volledig eigenaarschap en leiderschap in je werk? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Jouw bijdrage aan het avontuur

We transformeren de manier waarop de bouwsector werkt door GenAI in ons platform te integreren. Als Senior AI Engineer val je binnen het team Data Insights en rapporteer je rechtstreeks aan de Head of Data. Jij bent de architect achter de AI-mogelijkheden die de kernwaarde van 12Build versterken. Je bouwt niet zomaar losse stukjes; je ontwerpt een gedeelde AI-architectuur dat door al onze product-teams veilig gebruikt wordt.

Wat bedoelen we dan precies? 🔍

Hands-on Ontwikkeling:  In deze rol ben je hands-on verantwoordelijk voor het ontwikkelen van een AI-service waar onze product teams gebruik van maken. Je schrijft robuuste code en bouwt vanaf de grond af aan.

AI-Features in Productie:  Je brengt zelfstandig kritieke features in productie, variërend van pipelines voor geautomatiseerde data-verrijking tot real-time voorspellingsmodellen en geavanceerde RAG-systemen voor onze platform features.

Architectuur & Multi-Model Routing:  Jij bepaalt de standaarden (zoals observability, veiligheid en kosten) en implementeert slimme multi-model routing tussen bijvoorbeeld Gemini en OpenAI.

Kennis Delen & Technische Lead:  Je deelt je kennis en mentort je collega's, maar je zwaartepunt ligt bij het shippen van hoogwaardige AI-features. Je zorgt ervoor dat onze systemen klaar zijn voor de schaal van morgen en trekt de kar door zelf complexe technische uitdagingen in code op te lossen.

🎯 Onze missie:

"To architect and deploy AI services and capabilities that amplify 12Build’s core value, transitioning from data-informed to AI-driven customer value, and embedding predictive excellence into our platform to solve complex user problems."

Sven’s tip for new 12Builders:

“Finding your own style and using it to inspire your colleagues is strongly encouraged!”

Wie is 12Build?

Met een gezonde dosis  Drive, Openness en Happiness  bouwen we aan een transparante bouwsector. We zijn niet alleen een SaaS-platform dat bouwbedrijven met elkaar verbindt en samenwerking bevordert, we zijn ook marktleider in Nederland. We bestaan al bijna twintig jaar en we groeien nog steeds. Ons team bestaat nu uit meer dan 90 collega's, die samenwerken vanuit twee kantoren en verschillende thuiskantoren in heel Europa. Een groot deel van de bouwwereld in de Benelux, Duitsland en Denemarken werkt al op ons platform en gebruikt onze software dagelijks.  En we hebben de ambitie om heel Europa te veroveren!  🚀

Onze tools & tech stack  🔨  Binnen ons datateam zijn we continu bezig om ons te verrijken met de nieuwste AI- en cloudtechnologieën. Wij werken onder andere met:

AI & LLMOps:  Gemini, Open

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer (Onboarding & Enablement)
jobs.description:
We turn every customer interaction into an opportunity. We connect conversations, customer data and payments with AI Agents so that companies can deliver personal customer journeys at scale: both online and in person.

“The entire customer journey. One platform”

What we value

Every  CM.com  colleague, connects to our  4 shared values :

Drive and Lead

You take initiative, make decisions and recognize opportunities. Making mistakes is part of moving forward.

Grow and Learn

The growth of our colleagues and our customers is our priority. You like to experiment, learn continuously and actively share knowledge and insights with others.

Together and Care

We work together and we believe that diverse perspectives lead to stronger outcomes. You value the social side of work, you show genuine interest and care about one another’s well-being.

Speed and Change

By welcoming AI Agents into our organisation, we fundamentally change how work is done. You are comfortable with change and you love working in a high paced environment.

The Role

As a Full Stack Developer in the Onboarding & Enablement team, you'll own the front door of  CM.com  connectivity: the self service experience where customers sign up and start messaging in minutes, without a sales call or a single email. It is one of the most important topics at  CM.com  today, and your team is the conductor behind it.  In today's tech market, speed wins. Customers choose the provider they can start with right now, and they value ease over a long list of requirements. Think of how quickly you can take out a phone subscription: that is the experience we want to offer. Our customers are people, but increasingly also AI agents, and neither wants to wait for a callback.  Behind that one simple interface sits a complex platform. Every channel works differently. For example: WhatsApp runs via Meta, RCS via Google and Orange, and more channels and suppliers are joining. Customers should never notice any of that. The complexity is ours, not theirs.

You will

Build the self service onboarding experience that takes customers from sign up to their first message in minutes

Turn every customer request into the right configuration across our own systems and external suppliers, fully automated

Make it easy to plug in new channels and supplier partnerships, so the platform grows without adding complexity for the customer

Drive automation across the full customer journey, for people and AI agents alike

Own your work from idea to production, including how it runs on our infrastructure

Use AI tools actively to improve your own work: experiment, automate, and share what works with your team

Medior to senior full stack developer with hands on experience in both front end and back end

Strong in Angular on the front end, and in C# and .NET on the back end

Solid knowledge of relational databases, such as SQL Server or PostgreSQL

Fluent in English and Dutch

Nice to have: experience with DevOps or system engineer

jobs.title: (Senior) GEO Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
At idealo, we've built a strong SEO foundation. Now, we're looking to take the next step. As AI-powered search experiences such as ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Gemini increasingly influence how people research products and make purchasing decisions, we want to ensure idealo becomes a trusted and frequently cited source within these new shopping journeys.  As our  GEO Manager , you'll take ownership of developing Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) as an additional growth discipline alongside our established SEO activities. Combining your technical SEO expertise with hands-on experience in AI search optimization, you'll develop our GEO strategy, establish meaningful visibility monitoring, and drive experimentation to understand what makes content and data discoverable, relevant, and citable by generative AI systems.  You'll work closely with our SEO team and collaborate across Product, Engineering, Content, Brand, and Communications to turn emerging opportunities into scalable solutions.

About your new role

GEO Strategy & Development:  You develop and drive idealo's GEO strategy and experimentation roadmap, building on our existing SEO foundation. You identify opportunities across generative search platforms and AI-assisted shopping journeys, translating emerging developments into actionable initiatives aligned with our broader SEO and business objectives.

AI Visibility & Performance Monitoring:  You establish and continuously improve a GEO monitoring framework covering platforms such as ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews. You define relevant KPIs, including mention and citation rates, share of voice, sentiment, and positioning within AI-generated answers, and develop dashboards that make performance and progress transparent to different stakeholders.

Technical GEO Optimization:  You leverage your technical SEO expertise to improve how generative AI systems discover, interpret, and reference idealo's content. This includes optimizing structured data ( Schema.org ), semantic relationships, product and offer information, and identifying technical opportunities to strengthen our visibility and accessibility across AI-powered search experiences.

Experimentation & Competitive Analysis:  You design, implement, and evaluate GEO experiments, analyze idealo's visibility against relevant competitors, and translate findings into concrete optimization measures. You continuously assess emerging GEO tools, methodologies, and platform capabilities to improve our approach.

AI Shopping & Content Optimization:  You explore how idealo's product, pricing, and offer data can become a valuable information source for AI agents and agentic commerce. Together with Content Marketing, you assess existing content and develop answer-focused, well-structured formats that strengthen relevance, authority, and citation potential.

Cross-functional Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing:  You connect technical SEO and GEO requirements with Prod

jobs.description:

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

This includes the communications that help players discover, understand, and engage with the game, its content, events, campaigns, and broader brand experience across in-game and external channels.

You will partner closely with Product Marketing, Product Management, Game Design, Creative Production, Community, Social, Direct Marketing, Communications, Production, regional teams, and external language partners.   • Manage language partners and resources.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Executive, Healthcare and Life Sciences - US-Based

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue  and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the  world’s largest fully remote workforce .

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

Job Summary:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise provider, payer and life sciences clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, management consulting, and AI-enabled transformation. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.

This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and to establish Toptal as a core services provider embedded in your clients’ critical initiatives.

This is a remote position with concentrated field work across the US. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Job Summary:

Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations are transforming due to regulatory changes, and pressure to perform far outpacing their current abilities. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across therapeutic development, care delivery and healthcare financing. Toptal’s Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical already partners with some of the largest organizations in the world on exactly this work.

3 - 7 years of experience in the payment industry, with a focus on underwriting, transaction monitoring, customer support

At  AudioEye , we believe access to digital content is a fundamental right, not a privilege. Our mission is clear: eliminate every barrier to digital accessibility so that everyone, regardless of ability, can experience the web without limitations.

We are a team of passionate problem-solvers who are driven by purpose and impact. Every challenge we tackle moves us closer to a future where creating accessible experiences is the standard. If you’re looking for meaningful work where you can drive real change, influence how people with disabilities experience the internet, and be part of a mission that matters, AudioEye is the place for you.

The Staff Engineer role helps to drive the technical direction of AudioEye’s platform and tackles complex challenges in digital accessibility. The position is responsible for designing and building large-scale, reliable systems that detect, remediate, and prevent accessibility issues across millions of websites, using AI and agentic development as a core part of how the work gets done. This role collaborates closely with the Product and Design teams to deliver systems that create measurable impact for customers and end users. It requires strong ownership, autonomy, and a focus on solving meaningful technical problems at scale.

Technically lead one or more engineering teams through needs assessment, system design, implementation, and operations automation

Drive the technical roadmap, balancing short-term delivery with long-term sustainability

Partner with Product, Design, and engineers to build systems that help customers respond quickly to risk, while keeping reliability, security, and data consistency high

Build web-scale systems with strong grounding in service-oriented architecture, data modeling, performance, and end-to-end delivery

Understand customer and end-user needs and turn them into measurable value

Own problems across stacks, teams, and roles, with a bias for action

Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows daily to design, build, test, and operate software without lowering the quality bar. Delegate to agents, then review, verify, and take accountability for the output

Evaluate new AI development tools and adopt those that measurably improve delivery

Mentor and coach engineers on requirements, system design, problem-solving, and practical AI-assisted development, including prompting, context management, and knowing when not to trust the output

Help define team standards for responsible AI use across code review, testing, security, and data handling

Find opportunities to build AI capabilities into our products and internal tooling

Driven by the rapid digital transformation of businesses across Europe, demand for high-capacity, reliable connectivity from Enterprise customers continues to grow.   • Support the development and growth of selected existing accounts, identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling.
  • Effectively manage sales activity and pipeline through Salesforce.com, ensuring accurate reporting and data integrity

jobs.description:
Description

QuantumDiamonds is building the world’s first commercial quantum sensing tools for chip failure analysis. As our Research Software Engineering Intern in Pre-Development, you bring our measurement software together. A measurement protocol is the recipe our Quantum Diamond Microscope (QDm) follows for one measurement: how laser, microwaves and camera are sequenced and timed, and how raw camera frames become a magnetic field image of a chip. Our engineers write new protocols whenever they test a new idea, and several backends for running them grew in parallel. You turn them into one shared Python framework that our engineers extend.  The challenge is a framework R&D still uses long after your internship: flexible enough that a new protocol is a day’s work, automated enough that a measurement runs without someone watching it, and structured enough that the next engineer extends it without reading all of it. An experienced colleague from the team mentors you and sets the architecture; you make that trade-off real in code, working with Claude Code every day, as our engineers do.  This is a full-time internship for 6 months, during or after your studies, starting as soon as possible.

Who we are

Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

Why join QuantumDiamonds?

Picture this:

Quantum sensors that see  inside  the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.

Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.

Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.

An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.

Still unsure about why joining us?

You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.

From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.

Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.

You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.

Let’s make the invisible visible!

What will you do

Bring the measurement software of Pre-Development together into one shared Python framework, to a target architecture your mentor defines, and migrate the existing measurement protocols onto it.

jobs.description:

Roblox’s data platform processes petabytes of data daily, powering analytics, ML, and product decisions. The Data Platform Compute team owns the compute layer underneath it: the Kubernetes (EKS) clusters where all of Roblox’s Spark workloads run, and the software that lets engineers, analysts, and ML practitioners submit and run that work reliably and cost-effectively.

As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will build and operate the systems that sit between our users and the cluster. These include the Spark job submission service, our internal Spark libraries, interactive notebook compute, and cluster lifecycle automation. You’ll have real ownership, you’ll work on problems where the design is not yet settled, and you’ll help decide which technologies Roblox adopts next.

You Will:

  • Build and own core compute platform services: Design, build, and operate the software behind Spark job submission, including APIs, scheduling integration, and the libraries users depend on.
  • Launch interactive Spark at scale: Deliver Spark Connect to support notebook workflows, including provisioning and managing the EKS compute that backs them, with sensible isolation, resource limits, and cost controls.
  • Run a safe, automated cluster fleet: Build fleet management automation for EKS, such as blue-green rollouts that validate new AMIs and Kubernetes versions before they reach production workloads, with minimal disruption to running jobs.
  • Make jobs run better without user effort: Develop our auto-tuner, which analyzes Spark history and event logs to recommend or apply job configuration changes that improve performance and reduce cost.
  • Own batch scheduling on Kubernetes: Operate and upgrade our YuniKorn-based scheduling, including queue design, quotas, fairness across tenants, and version upgrades.

We build the isolation layers that contain untrusted and semi-trusted code. You will design, build, and harden process sandboxes across one or more of Linux, macOS, and Windows, the last line of defense when something inside goes wrong. This is a deep systems role for someone who thinks in terms of attack surface, threat models, and the exact boundary between trusted and untrusted.

  • Design and implement sandboxes using platform primitives: nsjail, seccomp-bpf, namespaces, cgroups, and Landlock on Linux; the Seatbelt (sandbox_init / SBPL) and related mechanisms on macOS; AppContainer, job objects, restricted tokens, and integrity levels on Windows.

  • Make deliberate engineering tradeoffs between isolation strength, performance, compatibility, and maintainability, and document the reasoning.
  • Write threat models, review designs, and respond to sandbox escapes and hardening findings.

You Have:

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the OS security model on at least one of Linux, macOS, or Windows, and the sandboxing primitives that platform provides.
  • Strong grasp of attack surface analysis: how sandboxes are escaped and how to shrink the ways in.
  • Fluency in the boundary between sandbox and host (brokers, IPC, syscall filtering, privilege separation) and how to design a minimal, well-audited interface.
  • Systems programming in C, C++, or Rust; comfort at the syscall and kernel-interfac

The Game Engine team is broadly split into departments — Audio-Video-Communication, Avatar, Core AI, Digital Matter, Productivity, and Systems. This position is for the Systems Runtime pod.

The Runtime pod builds and maintains the foundational C++ components that power the entire Roblox engine and Studio stack. We own the runtime layer — the performance, efficiency, and usability of the core primitives that every other engineering team relies on. Think of Runtime as the “standard library” and execution engine for Roblox's C++ world. Our ownership centers on three pillars:

  • Concurrency System — our task scheduler and fiber runtime power how work is parallelized across CPU cores, letting teams scale features across platforms while keeping code understandable and debuggable.
  • Memory System — we own the engine's memory allocator stack, tracking pipelines, and observability tooling to make memory behavior predictable and prevent leaks and fragmentation.
  • Profiling and Observability — we build and evolve the MicroProfiler and telemetry pipelines to help engineers diagnose real-world regressions and keep the client fast at global scale.

This role centers on our Concurrency system. You will own the scheduler and fiber runtime that the rest of the engine is built on, research and implement the performance work needed for 3K-player servers and genre expansion initiatives, and act as the point of contact other engine teams come to with concurrency asks. You will debug real production failures across PC, Mac, mobile, and console, and build deep intuition for how compilers, CPU architectures, and operating systems interact. About the Developer Experience team

The Developer Experience (DevX) team owns how developers learn and build on Together AI. We run the documentation site, API reference, quickstarts, cookbooks, and the tooling that keeps all of it accurate as the platform ships new models and features every week.

We treat docs as a product and as code. Content lives in Git, publishes through Mintlify, and stays in sync with the API through CI/CD automation built on GitHub Actions. We also write for two audiences at once: the human developer reading a guide, and the AI coding agent pulling our docs into its context window. Our Global Structure

Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Your job is to make sure every payout and transaction lands with the right person.

We have spent years getting very good at protecting the things a marketplace has always had to protect: checkout fraud, account takeover, courier abuse. But we are no longer only a marketplace. We now issue banking products, lend to merchants, move instant payouts to couriers, and collect cash on the doorstep. Every one of those is a new way for money to leave the platform.

This is a new team, and it owns that surface: fraud wherever money moves through the platform. Who receives it, who lends it, who collects it, and who holds it in a financial account. Think instant payout rails, merchant cash advances, and platform-issued banking and earned-wage products serving millions of couriers and merchants. These are live loss surfaces, and the volume grows with every financial product we launch.

You will design and ship real-time detection and automated enforcement for our financial products across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo. The work is high-throughput, low-latency, and unusually consequential: a rule you ship on Monday can stop a serious loss by Friday. It is also close to greenfield, so you will be setting the patterns every future financial product inherits on day one.

This role will be based in  London ,  UK  as one of the founding engineering roles in our London hub, working closely with our teams in Helsinki and Berlin.

Build and maintain high-throughput, low-latency backend services in Go that score financial events in real time, including payout enrollments, bank account links, credit applications, and account-to-account transfers.

Design fraud detection and automated enforcement for our financial products end to end: from signal collection through to the decision that blocks a fraudulent payout.

Build on and extend our shared fraud decisioning platform, so signals, rules, and models work across all three of our brands instead of being rebuilt three times.

Partner closely with risk analysts, data scientists, and product managers to turn observed fraud patterns into shipped detection, and to know when a rule, a model, or a product change is the right answer.

Work across team boundaries with our account security, payments fraud, and financial product teams. We build on their signals rather than rebuild them, so clean interfaces matter.

Contribute to architectural discussions and technical decisions as we establish the fraud infrastructure baseline for financial products, with support from senior engineers on the team.

We believe the future of finance operations is not faster clicking: it’s

no clicking at all

🫳 🎤

Finance teams shouldn’t spend their days moving data from one screen to another. Software should do the operational work, and humans should focus on reviewing, approving, and making the decisions that matter.

That’s the direction we’re building toward: an

agent-driven finance platform

We started in 2022 with a small team and a rough first version of the product. Three years later, we’re working with major companies across France, the UK, and the US while choosing to keep our team small and human-sized.

We moved fast, shipped a lot, and not everything was built in a perfect way. But it helped us learn quickly, sign real customers, and prove that the problem we’re solving truly matters.

In 2024, investors trusted us with a $25M Series A. That gives us the chance to keep growing while also strengthening our foundations and building the system that will power this agent-driven future.

Today, we’re about 35 people from many different countries, and we’re looking for a few amazing humans to join the next chapter. 🤗

You’ll help build a product that real finance teams rely on every day.

For us, engineering is not just about clean code, it’s about reliability, clarity, and trust, especially when money and automation are involved.

In a typical week, you might:

Design and implement new services for a product feature.

Refactor an early service to make it more robust.

Investigate a performance or production issue.

Work with product and frontend to shape a new feature.

Review code and help teammates improve.

Build backend tools that our AI agents use to perform real finance operations.

Design safe, deterministic workflows where agents propose actions and humans review them.

Your time will be split between

building new features

and

improving what already exists

. Both matter.

You won’t just build endpoints. You’ll help shape the

execution layer

that our agents rely on: the APIs, data models, and workflows that let them act safely in production.

You’ll work closely with product, frontend, and customer-facing teams. We expect engineers to take ownership of parts of the system and help make them more reliable over time.

💻

Our stack evolves based on our challenges, but we care more about good design than trendy tools 🙏

jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - Behavior AI
jobs.description:
The Behavior AI team builds the AI-based anomaly detection behind Datadog's security products. Our models learn what normal looks like across the billions of logs, events, and telemetry records flowing through the platform every second, and they flag the behavior that does not fit, on every record, in real time, at a cost that makes sense at our scale. What we build does not ship to a single feature. The same models power detection across many of Datadog's security products at once, so the work has impact well beyond any one team. Large general-purpose models are too slow and too expensive to run in that path, so we take the opposite approach: small, custom models, designed for high-throughput stream processing and optimized to run cheaply on every record.

We are hiring a Senior Applied Scientist to build these models from start to finish. You will contribute to designing the architecture, training at scale, and the optimization work that takes a model from training to running efficiently on production traffic. This optimization requires a deep understanding of the constraints imposed by both the software and the hardware, together with the applied mathematics to work within them: often it comes down to finding a mathematical reformulation that fits those constraints better, and that judgment can decide whether a model reaches production at all.

The work involves a number of open questions. How do you obtain most of the quality of a large model from one that is far smaller and cheap enough to run on the full stream? Where is it worth trading exactness for speed, and how do you reason about the error you accept? jobs.title: Senior Applied Scientist - AI Platform
jobs.description:
AI Platform builds the foundations of Datadog's AI efforts. The org is 70+ people organised in three pillars: training and serving (GPU clusters, distributed training, low-level infrastructure), agents (agent harnesses, memory systems, the internal AI gateway that routes every LLM request at Datadog), and evaluation and experimentation. This role sits in the evaluation and experimentation pillar, which owns Datadog's shared annotation and evaluation infrastructure — including the evaluation scenario store and the telemetry archival systems used across the Bits org. Together they let an agent travel back in time and query what Datadog looked like at the exact moment an incident happened, so scenarios can be replayed and agent performance tracked over time.

Specifically, you'll be the first applied scientist on GenSim (Generative Simulations), the team that builds the environments Datadog's agents learn in. GenSim doesn't replay sampled telemetry — it stands up real, fully instrumented applications that talk to Datadog, drives them with representative traffic, injects controlled failures, and records what happens. Because GenSim injected the failure, it knows the ground truth. That corpus — hundreds of postmortem-derived scenarios and thousands of runnable applications — is today the primary source of post-training data for Datadog's own SRE model, and the substrate that Bits AI SRE and our other agents are trained and evaluated against.

The team has no applied science support today and is learning post-training data methodology on the fly. That's the gap this role fills, and the open questions are the interesting part. How do you tell whether a generated environment is actually representative of the messy, incomplete telemetry real customers run — rather than a suspiciously clean one where every monitor exists and every service emits complete logs? How do you make injected problems genuinely hard, and how do you even measure difficulty? How do you define and control the quality of post-training data when correctness, representativeness and difficulty pull in different directions? How do you evaluate an agent end to end when the trajectory is non-deterministic? Creating simulated agent environments for monitoring and SRE work is not well solved in open source or in published research, and Datadog is the leading company in this field. If those are the problems you want to spend your time on, come build this with us.

  • Own the applied science direction for GenSim: set the methodology and the forward-looking technical calls on how simulated environments and post-training data should be built, on a team where that decision-making does not exist yet.

About the job

Own the reliability of AI compute hardware where lab discovery becomes data centre reality.

Graphcore is building the hardware and systems infrastructure needed for the next generation of AI breakthroughs. This role helps prove those platforms work when complexity, scale and pressure increase.

You will lead advanced operational, diagnostic and engineering support across lab and data centre environments. Your work will improve hardware bring-up, validation and troubleshooting for AI compute platforms.

You will diagnose failures across server blades, racks, power systems, thermal behaviour, network configuration and BIOS/BMC issues. You will turn hard problems into clear root cause analysis, corrective action and better operating practice.

This is hands-on engineering with visible impact. You will support new platforms from early bring-up through deployment, helping Graphcore move faster with confidence.

The team and culture

You will work with Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, server engineering, firmware, platform architects and data centre operations. Problems are solved close to the hardware, with clear evidence and direct ownership.

The team moves quickly during bring-up and validation cycles. Engineers are expected to act fast, take responsibility and speak up when something needs attention.

Decisions are shaped by data, system behaviour and practical engineering judgement. You will guide others, improve documentation and help raise the standard of hardware diagnostics.

· Strong knowledge of server hardware architectures and board-level debugging

· Confidence working across engineering, platform and data centre teams

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Claude is trained and served on hardware in data centers Anthropic operates and in sites partners build and run for us. DCSE secures that footprint: the sites, the hardware moving through them, and the people and vendors who touch it. Security at that scale runs on data, and you'll be the engineer who owns it and the systems that produce it: component-level hardware inventory and chain of custody, fed by software that runs at our sites and on hosts, and continuous control monitoring, with the posture calculations that decide what each site is cleared to run.

You set the architecture, agree schemas and interfaces with the teams, operators and vendors that own the sources, build the pipelines, stores and tools, and run what you ship. jobs.description:
Full-time · On-site (Paris Marseille)

The sea is the physical layer of the economy—the conduit for our energy, communications, and trade. It is also Europe’s exposed flank. Pelagon is building the answer.  Founded by  Aymeric  (serial deeptech entrepreneur; founded & exited Scortex, Leading AI solution for manufacturing quality) and  Gauthier  (Navy officer and McKinsey), Pelagon is building a foundational multimodal acoustic model for autonomous maritime protection (underwater and surface) in service of European sovereignty. It will be deployed on a distributed, autonomous network of vectors (UUVs, buoys, sailbuoys, seabed…) to provide real-time understanding of underwater threats.  France and Europe have world-class acoustic engineers and a long history in underwater warfare. By bridging this expertise with modern physical-AI strategies (as seen in autonomous driving and robotics). Europe is still missing it’s naval NeoPrime, Pelagon aims to become to lead the way in autonomous marine protection—from detection to interception—partnering with leading navies, primes, and neo-primes, while also operating its own fleet as a service.  Pelagon is backed by  Hexa , the pioneer startup studio in Europe, which has launched 35+ companies, including unicorns like Front, Aircall, and Spendesk, combining €230m+ ARR and €750m raised.

Why this matters

The sea is the physical layer of the economy — and Europe's most exposed flank. jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Frontier AI is on track to be among the most consequential and most adversarially-targeted technology in the world. The capability curve is steep, the adversaries who want these systems are extremely well-resourced, and the security bar this will eventually require is well beyond where the industry operates today. Incremental hardening alone is not going to close that gap, so we need breakthroughs and a group of people to go find them.

Security Labs is that team. We run a portfolio of high-risk, high-expected-value security projects: the work that seems impractical until someone optimistic and stubborn enough actually tries it. Projects run on the order of weeks rather than quarters, and each one is either handed off to the Anthropic team that will own it in production or wound down with a writeup of what we learned. We expect a meaningful fraction of our bets not to land.

This team is intentionally scrappy and ambitious. We're intentionally iterating fast on high-risk research bets and we expect a meaningful fraction not to land. If a 30% project success rate sounds uncomfortable, or uncharted and chaotic territory isn’t both frightening and exciting, this probably isn't the right fit. There are other places in Anthropic Security doing important work with more structure, less risk, and more certain paths to positive outcomes.

The questions we're trying to answer include:

  • Can our core research workflows survive extreme isolation?
  • Can we replace trust with cryptographic guarantees?
  • Can the models themselves become our most effective security control?
  • What would it actually take to defend against a tier-1 state adversary, and how much of that can we build now?

Who we're looking for. We're hiring generalists with rare depth. You're a strong software engineer as a baseline, and on top of that you've gone deep in at least one area most engineers don't get near: firmware or hardware security, applied cryptography, OS / kernel / hypervisor internals, formal methods, reverse engineering, or high-assurance and cross-domain systems. You've built things under your own direction, you're comfortable jumping layers when the problem demands it, and you'd rather take a swing at something that might not work than ship the safe incremental thing. WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

DESIGN

What We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

GAME DESIGN INTERN

What You'll Do

We are looking for a Game Design Intern to join the Fortnite Events team and help create memorable large scale multiplayer experiences. You will work with internal and co-dev designers, artists, engineers and producers to prototype, implement and polish gameplay features for upcoming live events.

In this role, you will

  • Help design and implement gameplay features for live events
  • Learn how to prototype dynamic player experiences in a large scale client-server replicated environment and expand on those ideas
  • Work within level sequences to help align keyframed event triggers, work with cinematic artists to manage structure and timing, and implement gameplay features into the event
  • Participate in team playtests, providing and addressing feedback
  • Collaborate with others and independently iterate on work based on feedback and evolving needs
  • Clearly communicate updates, progress, and potential risks to relevant stakeholders
  • Make and update documents for designs, technical adjustments, or reference materials

What we're looking for

  • Practical experience with Unreal Engine
  • Proficiency with Blueprints and the Gameplay Ability System
  • Portfolio of playable projects demonstrating experience across the video game production cycle, including student, indie, or freelance work
  • Interest in Fortnite, particularly live events and ambitious, narrative-driven content
  • Experience with level design systems such as World Partition and Data Layers, Level Sequencer, and basic multiplayer replication
  • Ability to independently troubleshoot problems and use available resources to identify solutions to blocking issues
  • Ability to clearly communicate needs, risks, ideas, scope, and progress to the team
  • Abilit

jobs.title: Hard Surface Outsource Lead
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is searching for an experienced Hard Surface Outsourcing Lead to support and supervise creative hard surface content provided by outsource partners. Working alongside Hard Surface Art Leads, and reporting to the Hard Surface Cosmetics Lead, the Outsource Lead will provide front-line creative feedback for work submitted for Fortnite. Though the role will be mainly supervisory, the individual should be an experienced artist, having worked in AAA titles before, and have a solid hands-on art background, with a very strong foundation of 3D modelling for both hard and soft surfaces. The ideal candidate would be a talented 3D artist who is able to communicate equally effectively, both with outsource partners and internal teams, to ensure the timely delivery of high quality assets to the next stage in the art pipeline. Their skills will include; a keen artistic eye for ‘clean’ 3D modeling, documenting existing pipelines, creating blockouts, paintovers and exemplar assets and, ultimately, providing clear visual feedback to vendors at each stage of the process.

In this role, you will

  • Work closely with the HS Cosmetics Lead and HS Art Leads to pull together clear creative direction for the assets to be created, and then ensure this information is packaged and conveyed to the Vendor as clearly as possible. Work with Directors, Production, and internal partners to evaluate, hire, and onboard vendors
  • Collect or generate detailed documentation, video reference, and examples of art asset production, procedures, and engine requirements to support the external vendors
  • If required, making any needed fixes to keep assets consistent and technically game ready as they’re handed off from the outsource partner
  • Clearly communicating modeling and paint feedback to the outsource partner, and ensuring those creative notes and goals are met. Informing leadership in the event that isn’t happening
  • Communicating and partnering with the HS implementation team ensuring outsourced assets are ingested into the pipeline and engine correctly

jobs.title: Manager, Software Engineering (Services Lead) - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.location: Los Angeles, USA; Redwood City, USA
jobs.description:
Riot engineers bring deep knowledge of specific technical areas but also value the opportunity to work in a variety of broader domains. As Engineering Managers, we gain organizational alignment by building a strong engineering vision and offering creative solutions to organizational design. We also serve as mentors for a team of engineers, overseeing their performance and trying to find stretch opportunities for their growth while maintaining a focus on results.

As a Manager, Software Engineering within Riot Discovery Studio, you will report to the Tech Director on an unpublished R&D product, leading a team of internal and external engineers to support product exploration, integrate and extend critical backend technologies, and scale our technology to meet the needs of a live Riot title. You will be accountable for all technical decisions of your team’s focus areas and help shape the product. You will own the technical health of the product's backend services from prototype through live operation, including architecture, scalability, reliability, observability, deployment, incident response, and infrastructure cost. You will be hands-on in implementation, at least initially.

Responsibilities:

  • Support defining the engineering strategy and technical roadmap to develop our global backend infrastructure with an understanding of our audience and product goals
  • Manage and scale an engineering team to support product needs through various development stages (i.e. pre-production, production, and post-launch)
  • Partner with product and delivery as they define product features and product roadmap
  • Collaborate and coordinate with Riot Central technology teams to efficiently deliver world-class solutions
  • Direct development and manage performance of external engineers in other geographies
  • Collaborate in technical/architectural discussions, provide direction and drive decision-making
  • Drive the planning and execution of engineering work including requirements gathering, technical discovery, technical design, and work breakdown and estimation.
  • Own the technical success of the services team, including operational excellence and cost in live environments
  • Identify, interview, and hire software engineers to support team and Riot hiring goals
  • Support engineers with performance management and career development, including stretch opportunities for them to grow
  • Create a culture of leadership across engineering by seeking different perspectives at all levels to solve problems and contribute ideas

Required Qualifications:

  • 6+ years of experience as a software engineer
  • 4+ years of game development experience working in various platforms (i.e. mobile, console, PC, etc.)
  • 2+ years experience in a leadership position, working directly on the production of a game as an Engineering Manager

Data Warehouses (~60% of team domain)  — making Bloomreach data first-class in customer Databricks. Dashboards & Analytics Stack (~20%)  — moving Marketing reporting and dashboarding from the proprietary stack onto Databrick.

We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as  personal  and  business  bank accounts, we offer  joint accounts ,  accounts for 16-17 year olds , a  free kids account  and  credit cards  in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also  save ,  invest  and  combine their pensions  with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through  Monzo  ❤️

UK Remote |  £31,100 - £39,350 + Incentive Awards tied to your performance +

Benefits  |  Hear from the team  ✨

Start date:  Monday 18th January, 2027

⭐ About our Senior Financial Crime Business Banking Investigator Team

The Senior Financial Crime Business Banking Investigator team serves as Monzo’s frontline defence against complex economic crime, safeguarding our ecosystem and customers, from startups to established SMEs, against sophisticated fraud and money laundering. Operating within a specialised, risk-focused "Pillar," this critical operational team builds deep subject matter expertise to ensure financial integrity across the entire customer lifecycle. The team is responsible for conducting rigorous onboarding and ongoing compliance checks, unravelling complex financial crime typologies, and directly mitigating risk through thorough investigation, reporting, and account closures.

You’ll play a key role by...

Taking ownership of the most complex FinCrime Business Banking tasks,  including Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD) for high-risk businesses, Complex Customer Reviews (e.g., sensitive areas like Sexual Services flags), and multi-jurisdictional money muling investigations.

Writing, reviewing, and submitting high-quality Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs)  to the National Crime Agency (NCA), ensuring they meet the highest legal and evidential standards.

Maintaining a regular schedule on core investigative tasks  to sustain your competency levels, directly support the domain’s Service Level Agreements (SLAs), and remain connected to frontline challenges.

Actively coaching Investigators  on complex financial crime typologies, best practice, and performance improvement to help drive a culture of excellence.

Working closely with our Operations Analysts  to share emerging trends and ensure that operational guidance is continuously updated and effectively embedded across the domain.

You have deep KYB & AML expertise,  with significant experience conducting end-to-end business due diligence (KYB/EDD) and complex investigations within a regulated financial setting.

jobs.title: Technical Sales Specialist (Electrical Market)
jobs.description:
Ajax Systems  is an international tech company and the largest manufacturer of security systems in Europe, with over 4.5 million end users and 330K PRO users in more than 180 countries worldwide. The company offers end-to-end solutions for protecting homes and businesses оf any scale. To date, Ajax product portfolio includes 280 devices for intrusion protection, video surveillance, fire and life safety, and comfort and automation. The company employs 5, 000 specialists.

We develop local teams because we understand local experts best comprehend market specifics. The company has sales representatives worldwide, including Italy, Spain, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, the USA, Australia, South Africa and other regions. The Global Business Development team is like-minded people who share the ambitious goals of Ajax Systems.

The best software combined with powerful hardware has forever changed the perception of security systems for users and industry professionals. Being recognized at the biggest specialized exhibitions such as IFSEC, Expoprotection and Intersec, as well as winning prestigious awards from industry-leading media like PSI magazine and GIT SECURITY, today Ajax is one of the most awarded security systems in Europe.

Ajax Systems production includes four factories, two of which are located in Ukraine, one in Turkey and one in Vietnam. At the same time, the company's certification according to the ISO 14001 standard ensures a minimal impact of production on the environment. The selection of components for Ajax device manufacturing is determined by the presence of manufacturer declarations confirming compliance with RoHS requirements.

The company emerged against the backdrop of revolution and war. That's why resilience is the cornerstone of the brand's DNA, and the fight against evil by creating the best security and automation devices is Ajax unwavering mission.

Conduct on-site demonstrations and provide support within distributor branches to showcase our products and solutions to electricians and project teams.

Collaborate with distributor sales teams to support customer visits and live demonstrations, ensuring effective communication and technical assistance.

Facilitate training sessions, both commercial and technical, for distributor branches to enhance product knowledge and sales effectiveness.

Provide support for various events organized by distributors or our company, offering expertise from both commercial and technical perspectives.

Act as a liaison between customers and our headquarters (HO), filtering and forwarding technical inquiries and requests to the appropriate channels.

Coordinate and deliver certification programs, either through local sessions or webinars, to educate electrical customers on our products and solutions.

Regularly update selected distributor branches on new products, features, and functionalities, ensuring they are well-informed and equipped to promote our offerings effective

At  Instacart , we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering  Tailscale . If this job description resonates with you, please apply.  Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications.

We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are.
