jobs.title: Lead Technical Artist
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

We're looking for a Lead Technical Artist to guide a team of Technical Artists in building visually compelling, performant game worlds as part of our collaboration with Disney. Working closely with Art, Engineering, and Design, you'll translate project goals into practical tools, workflows, and technical solutions. This is a hands-on leadership role focused on day-to-day execution, team mentorship, and solving production challenges. You'll help deliver the studio's technical art direction.

In this role, you will

  • Profile game content and resolve performance bottlenecks in collaboration with Art and Engineering
  • Optimize geometry, materials, shaders, textures, lighting, foliage, and VFX to meet established performance and memory budgets
  • Help artists apply best practices for LODS, instancing, streaming, and content scalability across target platforms
  • Conduct content reviews and develop validation tools to identify technical issues early
  • Develop and maintain tools that support efficient environment creation, including terrain, foliage, procedural generation, and asset placement
  • Partner with Environment Art and Level Design to improve world-building workflows and troubleshoot production issues
  • Implement established standards for modular assets, materials, and content organization
  • Document tools and workflows, helping artists adopt them effectively
  • Lead the day-to-day work of a small Technical Art team, coordinating priorities and deliverables with Production and technical leadership
  • Mentor Technical Artists through feedback, technical reviews, and hands-on problem-solving
  • Balance individual contributions with delegation, giving team members clear ownership and opportunities to grow
  • Communicate progress, dependencies, and technical risks to project leadership
  • Coordinate Initiatives with Tech Art Leads on other projects working in the same development environment

jobs.title: Corporate Development Lead, Life Sciences
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is seeking an experienced Corporate Development leader to drive our strategic transactions in life sciences and biotech. Frontier AI is beginning to change how drugs are discovered, developed, and brought to patients, and Anthropic wants to help build that future responsibly. In this role, you will source and execute acquisitions, investments, and strategic partnerships with AI-native life sciences companies, partnering directly with Anthropic's leadership, research, and product teams to shape our strategy in the sector, grounded in Anthropic's strategic priorities.

The ideal candidate combines deep life sciences domain knowledge with technical fluency in AI and a record of closing complex transactions. You understand how R&D, clinical, and regulatory workflows actually run, you can tell a durable AI-native business from a thin wrapper, and you can assess a target's science, data, and compliance posture as rigorously as its financials. You care about AI safety and Anthropic's mission to build AI systems that are helpful, harmless, and honest, and you recognize the stakes of applying AI where patient safety and scientific integrity are on the line.

Join us in shaping how AI accelerates science and medicine while keeping it safe and beneficial for humanity. This role sits at the intersection of frontier AI research and life sciences, with direct impact on Anthropic's growth in one of its most consequential sectors.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and execute Anthropic's corporate development strategy in life sciences, covering acquihires, tuck-in acquisitions, minority investments, and strategic partnerships
  • Build and maintain a target pipeline across AI-native companies in drug discovery, clinical development, regulatory and medical writing, lab automation, and healthcare data infrastructure
  • Lead end-to-end transaction processes, from sourcing through diligence, negotiation, signing, and integration
  • Partner with research, product, engineering, and go-to-market teams to assess the technical, scientific, and commercial value of opportunities
  • Run sector-specific diligence, including scientific and data validation, regulatory posture (FDA, EMA, GxP, 21 CFR Part 11), data privacy (HIPAA, GDPR), quality systems, and IP
  • Assess build/partner/buy tradeoffs and competitive dynamics against incumbents, AI-native entrants, and other frontier AI labs
  • Structure and negotiate complex deals, including earnouts

jobs.title: Creative Advisor - Human Frontier Collective
jobs.description:
About the Collective

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC)’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI. As a Creative Advisor, you’ll bring your creative practice into direct collaboration with Scale’s research and ML teams. You’ll help them understand how work gets made in your field, develop new work together, and provide feedback on how AI models support—or fall short of—real creative processes.

What You’ll Do

  • Connect with other creators: Meet and learn from creatives and researchers across HFC and your industry.
  • Shape work in your domain: Share the taste, judgment, methods, and creative decisions behind your practice to help inform model development.
  • Create alongside the team: Collaborate on briefs and develop new work that helps explore what models can and cannot do in your field.
  • Partner with ML and research teams: Define what “good” looks like in your field, review model outputs, flag where AI falls short, and give feedback that shapes how models learn your craft.
  • Help peers understand the opportunity: Introduce other creators in your field to the program and share your experience contributing work.

Who Should Apply

We’re looking for leading creators in their field who are interested in shaping AI and how it’s changing creative work. No AI experience needed. Your expertise in your craft matters most, and being connected to others in your field is a plus. This is a paid, part-time role with a flexible schedule.

Why Join

  • Have a voice: Contribute your subject-matter expertise and perspective in your domain. Build the future by shaping frontier models.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work with ML and research teams and connect with other leading creatives.
  • Explore new creative possibilities: Make new work through paid, commissioned briefs that challenge what models are capable of doing.
  • Get paid for your expertise: Paid $300 hourly, with compensation, time commitment, and project scope shared during your interview.

Application Process

  1. Apply: Share your background and a link to your portfolio. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.
  2. Portfolio Review: Share one past project you’re proud of. Nothing is used without a signed agreement and payment, and we’ll follow up with next steps.
  3. Meet the Team: A paid conversation with our research and ML team to walk through your work.
  4. Get Started: Successful candidates are invited to join the Human Frontier Collective as a Creative Advisor.

jobs.title: Feed System Functional Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.  You will own the functional architecture and performance of the propellant feed system for a storable bipropellant propulsion system (MON3-MMH system). You will be responsible for ensuring the feed system delivers propellants to the thrusters within required specifications across the full mission envelope — from ground fill through operation, and recovery.

Role Overview  System Architecture

Define and maintain the functional architecture of the feed system including propellant tanks, lines, valves, filters, thrusters and instrumentation.

Perform system-level sizing, sensitivity analyses and functional simulations

System Development

Define functional requirements for subsystems based on propellant system analyses

Identify key verification and validation steps required at the system and subsystem level to demonstrate compliance with specification

Modeling & Analysis

Develop and maintain fluid system models (steady-state and transient) to predict pressure drop, flow rates, water hammer, thruster cross-coupling, and priming behavior.

Verify compliance between system nominal and off-nominal operation with subsystem operational domains (such as thruster envelope).

Analyze failure modes (leakage, contamination, cavitation, fluid hammer) and define mitigation strategies and design margins.

Verification & Test

Lead functional and performance verification: cold-flow, functional and hot-fire tests from component to assembly level .

Correlate test data against predictive models and update margins/requirements accordingly.

Integration Support

Support integration, qualification, and operations reviews (design reviews, FMEA, test readiness reviews).

Interface across design, test, and operations functions throughout the vehicle lifecycle.

Location  You will perform your duties principally at the Company's premises in Bordeaux and may be required to travel from time to time to our company’s premises in Munich in the course of your duties.

What we would love to see from you

Master’s and/or PhD degree in Aerospace Engineering or a related field

Proven experience with python and 0D - 1D fluid simulation tools (model development and analyses) - (e.g., EcosimPro or equivalent)

Hands-on experience in propulsion system design for launch vehicles, spacecraft, or space capsules, with direct exposure to liquid propulsion architectures.

Proven experience in version control systems and tools (e.g., Git or SVN)

Deep understanding of fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and compressible flow

jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Mistral is looking for AI Scientists with deep ML expertise and hands-on engineering experience to expand what our agentic tools can do across the engineering lifecycle — CAE (CFD, FEA, etc.) and EDA/Semi.  Working within the AI4Engineering Science team, your core work is building the pre and post-training data for Mistral's LLMs to reason about and execute real engineering tasks. Because Mistral trains its own frontier LLMs, the data and verifiers you design ship directly into models you can hold, a rare position, and the core of the job.

Alongside this, you'll help shape the agent architectures and harness that let these models operate reliably inside multi-step engineering workflows, not just answer isolated questions.  You'll work closely with domain experts across CAE and EDA or other domains to ground this work in how engineers actually work, and with the broader research team to translate that domain grounding into training signal and evaluation benchmarks that measure genuine task competence.  This is early-stage work, and that's the point: you'd be joining at the foundation, shaping the data, verifiers, and agent scaffolding that decide whether these systems become reliable or stay demo-grade. There's no inherited playbook, you'll help define what good looks like, and your work will set the direction the team builds on rather than extend an existing one.

What you will do

Design pretraining, SFT, and RL data for engineering tasks across CAD, CAE, and semiconductor/EDA

Define verifiers and evaluation criteria that capture what "correct" and "high-quality" actually mean for each engineering task, beyond surface-level plausibility

Design and improve agent architectures and harnesses: how models plan, call tools, recover from errors, and chain steps together across long-horizon engineering workflows

Build evaluation benchmarks and diagnostic tooling to identify where models fail on engineering tasks, and trace those failures back to gaps in data, reward design, or agent scaffolding

Collaborate with domain experts across CAE and EDA or other domains (and the science and solutions teams more broadly) to identify which engineering workflows are highest-value to target next

Contribute to Mistral's broader pre and post-training research, sharing findings and method

jobs.title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
jobs.description:
About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni)

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We're looking for a  motivated working student  to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do

Model quality evaluation:  Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.

Quantization research:  Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.

Build reproducible tooling:  Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.

Measure runtime performance:  Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program.

Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants.  Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements.  Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens.  Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Technicien(ne) Produit Maille Senior pour rejoindre notre pôle Développement Produit pour un CDD de 6 mois. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75).

Vos principales responsabilités seront :

Assurer la prise de mesures des modèles à chaque étape du développement (prototypes, shooting samples, shipment samples, size sets et pièces scellées).  Participer activement aux essayages aux côtés de la styliste, identifier les défauts de mise au point et proposer des solutions techniques adaptées.  Rédiger les commentaires techniques (fléchages, sections de montage, annotations en français ou en anglais) sur Illustrator et élaborer les fiches de mesures sur Excel.  Être l’interlocuteur privilégié des fournisseurs sur les aspects techniques tout au long du processus de mise au point, en français comme en anglais.  Contribuer aux projets transverses de l’équipe visant à améliorer et harmoniser le bien-aller des modèles.  Valider les lancements en production auprès des usines et définir les gradations adaptées.  Réaliser les tests au porter et au lavage, analyser les résultats et partager les conclusions avec les équipes Production, Qualité et Technique.  Contrôler la conformité des shipment samples et des pièces scellées en collaboration avec les équipes Qualité et Production, identifier les éventuelles non-conformités et assurer le suivi des actions correctives auprès des fournisseurs.  Assurer le suivi des réceptions de prototypes, effectuer les relances nécessaires et mettre à jour les outils de suivi de production.  Piloter le planning de mise au point en coordination avec l’équipe Production, dans le respect des échéances fixées.  Participer aux réunions consacrées aux conseils de taille et à l’analyse des taux de retour.

Vous serez garant(e) du bien-aller des modèles, depuis leur développement jusqu’à leur livraison.

Aber jeder Unternehmer kann einer werden – mit der richtigen Begleitung."  thexton armstrong wurde 2011 in den Niederlanden gegründet mit einer klaren Mission: KMU-Inhabern die Unterstützung geben, die sie wirklich brauchen – nicht als externe Berater, die Präsentationen liefern, sondern als Vertrauenspersonen, die langfristig an ihrer Seite bleiben.  Heute ist das Netzwerk in 5 Ländern aktiv, zählt über 100 Partner und hat Hunderte von KMU geholfen, profitabler, stabiler und besser managebar zu werden. In Deutschland startete das Franchise Ende 2024 – jetzt kommt Nord- und Ostdeutschland.  Als thexton armstrong Partner in Berlin, Hamburg, Hannover, Bremen, Leipzig, Dresden oder einer der anderen Metropolregionen der Region arbeiten Sie mit einem bewährten System, einer anerkannten Marke und einem Netzwerk gleichgesinnter Profis – europaweit.  Das Geschäftsmodell  Als Franchise Partner gewinnen Sie KMU-Inhaber (5-10 Klienten) als langfristige Mentoring-Mandate. Die Zusammenarbeit läuft über strukturierte KMU-Programme in drei Phasen:

Discovery Session – Sie knüpfen eine Verbindung, verstehen die persönliche Motivation des Unternehmers, seine Hoffnungen und Herausforderungen.

Profit Leakage Session – Mit dem thexton armstrong Online-Tool identifizieren Sie live, wo und wie viel Profit aus dem Unternehmen fließt. Sofortige, greifbare Erkenntnisse.

Proposal Session – Gemeinsam planen Sie die Zusammenarbeit: welches Programm, welche Ziele, welche Schritte.

Klienten unterschreiben Verträge mit monatlicher Abrechnung – das schafft planbare, wiederkehrende Einnahmen für Sie und entlastet die Cashflow-Planung des Klienten.  Ein typisches Klienten-Portfolio: 5–10 KMU mit Mandatslaufzeiten von 12+ Monaten. Viele Beziehungen dauern mehrere Jahre.  Ihre Aufgaben als Franchise Partner

Klientenakquisition: Sie identifizieren und gewinnen KMU-Inhaber in Ihrer Region – durch Netzwerkarbeit, Empfehlungen und aktives Outreach.

Business Mentoring: Sie begleiten Ihre Klienten langfristig bei Wachstum, Profitabilitätssteigerung, Restrukturierung und Unternehmensnachfolge.

Profit Leakage Analysen: Sie führen strukturierte Unternehmensanalysen mit dem thexton armstrong Online-Tool durch und präsentieren klare, umsetzbare Erkenntnisse.

Programmbegleitung: Sie steuern aktiv ein Portfolio von 5–10 KMU-Klienten durch maßgeschneiderte KMU-Programme (Wachstum, Stabilisierung, Exit).

Netzwerkaufbau: Sie etablieren sich als anerkannter KMU-Experte in Ihrer Region – durch IHK-Engagements, Vorträge, Events und digitale Präsenz.

Eigenes Unternehmertum: Sie führen Ihr eigenes Unternehmen – von der Akquisition über die Leistungserbringung bis zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung.

Community & Netzwerk: Sie nehmen an regelmäßigen Peer-Exchanges, Trainings und Best-Practice-Sessions mit dem europaweiten thexton armstrong Netzwerk teil.

Neustart ohne Neuan

jobs.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

Order Management sits at the center of how Figma turns contracts into revenue — every deal our Sales team closes passes through this team before it's invoiced. As part of the Revenue Operations team within Accounting, we own order form review, invoicing, and billing support for Sales and Support for a global customer base. As Figma grows, we're building the order-to-cash process for what comes next, and this role is a builder's seat: you'll take on our most complex orders while helping shape how orders get processed, reviewed, and automated as we scale.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you'll do at Figma:

  • Own the order process end to end — from contract review and order entry through to invoicing — processing orders accurately and within SLA, including our most complex work with validation for completeness, accuracy and policy compliance
  • Serve as a go-to resource for Sales and Support on billing and invoicing questions, and partner with cross functional partners to investigate discrepancies and booking blockers across systems — following up to conclusion
  • Detail-review routine orders processed by other analysts and our BPO partners, identifying error patterns and driving them to resolution
  • Play a key role in UAT for new products, SKUs, pricing models, and billing system releases — writing and executing test scripts, running end-to-end tests from order through billing, documenting bugs clearly, and working with cross functional partners to resolve
  • Support month-end and quarter-end close, including reconciliations, accruals, and data integrity across systems, while maintaining SOX controls, audit documentation, and the SOPs and test cases your areas run on
  • Take ownership of ad-hoc projects related to process improvement, system upgrades, or controls enhancements across the order-to-cash lifecycle

We'd love to hear from you if you have:

  • 3+ years of experience in order management, order-to-cash, billing operations, or revenue operations at a SaaS company
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce (RLM or CPQ), an ERP such as NetSuite, and a payment processor such as Stripe
  • Clear understanding of how order entry decisions flow downstream into billing and revenue
  • Advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills — pivots, XLOO

Wrapbook  is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting.

Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less.

The Opportunity - Senior Manager, Accounting - (Remote - USA / CANADA)

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Accounting who combines technical accounting expertise with a drive to build better systems, processes, and teams.

If you want to maintain existing processes, this isn’t the role for you. If you want to be accountable for the numbers, build the tooling that makes them faster and more reliable, and develop a team that does the same, it is.

Reporting to the Senior Director, Controller, you’ll own the monthly close, the financial statements, and the general ledger for a complex, multi-product fintech platform. You’ll own the quality of our financial statements and help shape the systems that produce them, with direct partnership across Engineering, Product, and Operations, as well as use AI in your own work to improve accuracy and efficiency.

We’re advancing an AI-driven transformation of our accounting function. With Rillet as our ERP and elements of the close already automated, you’ll have a strong platform to build on. The foundation however remains essential: accurate numbers, reconciliations and sound controls. From there, you’ll use technology to automate manual work, improve accuracy, and support growth. You should think in systems, challenge processes that rely on manual or repetitive effort, and recognize when a recurring reconciliation/task could become a controlled, automated workflow.

You’ll bring the technical accounting expertise and sound judgment to prepare us for our first financial statement audit and support our next stage of growth. You’ll translate complex transactions and new products into clear accounting policies, well-supported conclusions, and reliable financial reporting. By strengthening documentation, controls, and review practices, you’ll build an accounting foundation that meets audit expectations and scales with the business.

What you’ll do:

Own the financial statements from close to delivery. Run the monthly, quarterly, and annual close and review the income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow statement for accuracy and GAAP compliance.

Own the post-implementation build-out of Rillet (ERP) to a fully functional ERP. Build the rules and controls that drive how transactions post. Connect Rillet to our subledger and source systems so data flows in without manual entry; building a close that runs on  automation .

Redesign the ledger and chart of accounts for how the business operate

jobs.description:
At  Submittable , we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run  30,000 programs , welcomed  1.2 million applicants , and facilitated the distribution of  more than $10 billion  in funding through our products on behalf of our clients.

We are on a mission to help organizations accelerate their impact, so we are proud to partner with organizations focused on Equity & Social Justice, Children & Education, Creative & Arts, Health & Wellness, Economic Justice & Opportunity, and Environment & Climate. At Submittable, technology and purpose converge, offering a unique opportunity to contribute to meaningful change.

About the Role

Submittable is hiring a Vice President of Engineering who is deeply technical, works hands-on, and builds with AI every day. You will report to the CTO and run engineering day to day: delivery, quality, reliability, cost, and the people who make them happen.

We want a different VP than the old SaaS playbook produced. That playbook grew output by growing headcount and adding layers of management. We believe AI coding tools now let a small team of strong engineers ship what once took a team several times its size. We intend to run engineering that way. You will keep the organization lean, keep layers few, and raise output per engineer rather than the number of engineers.

You cannot lead that change from a slide deck. You need to know firsthand what it is like to ship production software with AI agents, including where they fail. We expect you to have done this yourself in the last 12 months and to keep doing it here. Plan on roughly a fifth of your week going to hands-on technical work: reading and writing code, reviewing pull requests, working incidents, and building the tools your teams use.

We are choosing depth over span. This is a hands-on leadership role for a small, senior team, not a role leading a large organization through layers of managers. If you want to make architecture calls, contribute and ship code, and help a lean team deliver well beyond its size, we want to talk.

What You'll Do

Run engineering day to day.  Turn the CTO's technical strategy and the product roadmap into plans, priorities, and shipped software.

Stay hands-on.  Review pull requests, prototype, debug production issues, and write tools. You should be able to pick up a ticket and ship it. Teams should trust your calls because of your technical judgment, not your title.

Make AI the default way we build.  Expect every engineer to work with AI coding agents (tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot) for design, coding, testing, and review. Show people how by doing it yourself, and remove whatever stops them.

We are looking for a Customer Success Manager to own the relationship with the customers connected to our out‑of‑home (OOH) delivery platform.

You will be the first contact for our customers. You know their numbers, and when a customer is stuck, you are the one who gets things moving inside GLS/NXT. Au sein de l'équipe Data Science d'Artefact, vous rejoignez une communauté d'experts en IA et Data en tant que Manager et référent technique. Rattaché(e) au CTO, vous jouez un rôle central dans le cadrage, la conception, le déploiement et le passage à l'échelle de solutions d'IA à fort impact business pour nos clients grands comptes.

Ce qu’on attend de vous :

En tant que Manager, vous garantissez l'excellence technique et la valeur délivrée sur vos projets (ML, GenAI, MLOps) tout en assurant l'encadrement, le coaching et le développement de carrière des Data Scientists. Vous êtes l'interlocuteur privilégié des décideurs (C-level), participez au rayonnement de l'expertise Artefact et pilotez la croissance de l'équipe.

Vos missions :

  • Piloter des projets IA de bout en bout : du cadrage des cas d'usage avec les parties prenantes business jusqu'à la mise en production de solutions mesurables.
  • Définir et garantir l'architecture technique des solutions : choix méthodologiques, validation de la donnée, industrialisation en environnement Cloud et application des meilleures pratiques MLOps & Software Engineering.
  • Accompagner, mentorer et faire grandir les Data Scientists : suivi de performance, planes de développement de carrière, staffing et maintien du bien-être de l'équipe au quotidien.
  • Être le référent technique et partenaire de confiance des clients : vulgariser les concepts IA complexes, évaluer les risques, le ROI et la faisabilité auprès des équipes C-level et opérationnelles.
  • Développer l'expertise technique interne : tester de nouvelles approches IA/GenAI, créer des accélérateurs réutilisables (outils, modules) et maintenir une veille technologique active.
  • Inculquer une culture de la rigueur et de la collaboration : organiser des revues de code, des ateliers de partage de connaissances et favoriser les synergies entre Data Scientists, Data Engineers et équipes métier.

Profil recherché :

  • Expérience & Leadership : 5 ans ou plus d'expérience concrète dans le développement de solutions Data/IA, avec une expérience éprouvée en gestion d'équipe et pilotage de projets complexes.
  • Expertise IA & Cloud : Solides compétences en Machine Learning appliqué, IA Générative, principes MLOps et industrialisation de workflows IA sur les environnements Cloud.
  • Posture & Management : Capacité à mentorer des juniors comme à challenger des seniors, avec une approche pragmatique, créative et orientée résolution de problèmes.
  • Relation Client & Impact : Excellente communication pour fédérer les équipes, piloter les parties prenantes et instaurer une relation de confiance durable avec les clients.

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil international spécialisé en Data et Intelligence Artificielle, présent dans plus de 20 pays avec plus de 2 500 collaborateurs.

Au sein de l’équipe Talent Acquisition France et sous la responsabilité de la Head of Talent Acquisition, tu pilotes en autonomie le recrutement des équipes Strat Data d’Artefact, sur des profils allant de Junior à Manager.

Partenaire des équipes opérationnelles, tu les accompagnes tout au long du processus afin de garantir des recrutements de qualité et une expérience candidat exigeante :

Piloter les recrutements de bout en bout

  • Garantir la bonne application du processus et des méthodes d’évaluation
  • Veiller à une expérience de recrutement de qualité pour les candidatures et les équipes internes

  • Une expérience confirmée en recrutement, idéalement dans le conseil/ ESN

  • Une capacité à gérer et prioriser un périmètre de recrutement en autonomie
  • Une posture de business partner, avec la capacité de conseiller et challenger
  • Une bonne maîtrise des outils de recrutement et un bon niveau d’anglais.

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

As a Business Systems Architect you will be an integral part of designing and building out Figma’s Financial systems landscape. You’ll be joining a small team so will have a broad purview over the different Accounting functions, and will have a specific focus on the Order-to-Cash and Revenue workstream. The company is growing fast so the need to revamp, rebuild, and expand our technology infrastructure will be an unending source of exciting projects. Outside of direct projects this is also a great opportunity to join the team at an early stage and help us define how a best in class business systems team should operate!

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Build and provide ongoing system architecture and design reviews to ensure our Order-to-Cash processes are best in class
  • Identify opportunities for configuration, integration, and process improvements across the Order-to-Cash and Revenue Recognition space
  • Align cross-functional teams on technical requirements and goals with regards to ERP functionalities and activities
  • Design and implement software solutions to increase automation, reduce risk, and create scalability
  • Mentor and guide junior team members, as well as provide input on the team’s recruiting efforts by participating in interviewing and hiring decisions

  • Serve as the subject matter expert on NetSuite ERP and provide end user training and support for our ERP and other ancillary Financial systems

  • Experience supporting ancillary Accounting systems (TripActions, Zip or Coupa, etc.)
  • A balanced skill set that can wear the hats of a Business Analyst, Project Manager and Technical Systems Analyst

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is looking for a Staff Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and partner with Consumer Revenue. Our mission is to make it easy for all users to discover, understand, buy, and keep Premium Products on Discord. In this role, you will set technical direction for the data systems that support Nitro, Shop, server monetization and gifting, and other consumer revenue experiences. You will build reliable data foundations that help teams understand performance, run experiments, and make better product and business decisions.

You’ll work closely with Data Science, Product, Finance, Data Platform, and engineering partners. If you’re excited to lead complex data engineering work, raise the quality of shared data products, and help a high-velocity consumer business grow, read on.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set technical direction for Consumer Revenue data engineering: identify foundational gaps, define scalable architectures and standards, and lead high-impact initiatives from design through adoption.
  • Design and own canonical data models and datasets for consumer monetization, including subscriptions and subscriber states, purchases and payments, Shop, gifting, and Orbs. Make these assets reliable, well-documented, and useful across product analytics, financial reporting, experimentation, and decision-making.
  • Build and evolve production data pipelines that transform source events and transactional data into accurate, trusted data products. Balance freshness, reliability, cost, and maintainability across batch and, where the use case calls for it, lower-latency processing.
  • Partner with Data Science, Product, Finance, and engineering teams to define and operationalize important business metrics—including subscriber, revenue, booking, retention, and product usage measures—and ensure definitions are consistent across reporting and experimentation.
  • Strengthen the data foundations behind high-velocity product work and revenue growth. Translate ambiguous questions into robust models, metrics, and analytical capabilities that help teams size opportunities, evaluate launches, and learn from experiments.
  • Establish data quality, testing, monitoring, and documentation practices for the data assets you own. Pay particular attention to accuracy, freshness, auditability, and edge cases in subscription, payment, and commerce data.
  • Improve self-service analytics by maintaining a discoverable semantic layer, reusable data models, and clear guidance

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Deepgram  is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Please note: This role does not sponsor Employment Pass

THE OPPORTUNITY

South East Asia is one of the world's most dynamic technology regions, and Singapore sits at the center of it: a hub where many of the world's leading technology companies base their regional teams, and where Deepgram is already seeing strong demand. Joining at the earliest stage of Deepgram's presence in the region, you will turn that demand into revenue: owning a territory end to end, winning new logos, and growing them over time. You will help shape how Deepgram sells across South East Asia rather than inheriting a finished playbook.

Your focus will be Singapore and the broader South East Asia region, selling across the full spectrum of the market, from fast-moving tech companies to large enterprises, as well as the major technology partners headquartered in Singapore. You will run both a direct motion and a co-sell motion, and the strength of the partner ecosystem here makes co-sell central to how you will win. This is a role for a full-cycle seller who is at home with technical buyers and energized by building something early.

Grafana Labs is looking for a technically fluent engineer who loves building powerful demos, explaining complex systems clearly, and helping SRE and platform engineering leaders understand the value of our open approach to observability.

Your work will help SRE and platform engineering leaders evaluate Grafana with confidence, equip sales engineers with better tools and talk tracks, and ensure our technical value shows up clearly and consistently across the entire customer journey.

This is a unique chance to shape how Grafana tells its story as we evolve our positioning in the AI era, strengthen seller enablement, and build a repeatable system for communicating product value.

Build strategic, buyer-focused demos, videos, workshops, and webinars

Create and maintain polished, narrative-driven demos

Host weekly cross-functional updates and conduct regular training session

jobs.title: Product Designer, Core Experience
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA • New York, NY • United States
jobs.description:
Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We’re looking for technically-minded product designers who are excited to shape how teams build together. At Figma, design isn’t just how something looks—it’s how it works, how it feels, and how it scales. Our designers are systems thinkers, prototypers, storytellers, and craftspeople who care deeply about quality and collaboration. In this role, you’ll turn ambiguity into clarity, push the product forward with engineers, PMs, and researchers, and help us invent new ways for people to design and build products together.

The Core Experience team shapes how people create in Figma—from foundational tools like Auto Layout and Text to the interactions that make working on the canvas feel intuitive and precise. We’re looking for an experienced Product Designer to lead major efforts across the core editor and help define how it evolves as AI and code change the way people build products. You’ll bring a strong point of view, deep interaction design craft, and curiosity about complex systems. Working closely with engineering, product, research, and designers across Figma, you’ll set direction and stay hands-on, turning ambitious ideas into experiences people use every day.

With an eye for simplicity and craft, curiosity for complex systems, and an appetite for technical challenges, you can help define the future of how software is made.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

  • Lead the design of core editor experiences, including foundational concepts like Auto Layout, Text, and canvas interactions, from identifying opportunities through prototyping, shipping, and iteration
  • Help us define and champion a clear vision for how the editor should evolve, translating that vision into concrete proposals, design principles, and priorities with product and engineering partners
  • Explore how direct manipulation, AI, and code can work together, prototyping ways for people to move between generating, editing, and refining their work while retaining creative control
  • Ground decisions in user research, product data, and close observation of how people create, using that evidence to test assumptions and refine your point of view
  • Contribute to our design org’s culture by participating in design critiques, mentoring peers, and sharing best practices across teams

Help Scout  started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. ✈  The

Challenge:  Aircraft and airlines generate and collect massive amounts of data, but this data is hardly aggregated and leveraged in the industry. 💻  Our

Solution:  At  Skailark , we help airlines make smarter decisions — financially and environmentally. We’ve built a  digital twin of the global aviation market , modeling every seat on every flight across every airline.

Trusted by airlines like  American Airlines, British Airways, Finnair, and Transavia

and airports such as London Heathrow,  Skailark is where  complex data meets real impact.

Ready to help shape the future of aviation?

Tasks

We are looking for two Senior Managers Aviation Data with a passion for building and expanding our digital twin of the global aviation market. You will shape the parts of our models that match your background and interests, from how aircraft and airline networks operate to what drives airline costs and financial performance. Working closely with our Head of Product, you will turn how aviation works in practice into accurate, scalable models. You will lead and develop a small team of 2–3 business analysts while staying hands-on yourself. From developing new models and improving existing ones to making sure the data behind them is accurate and reliable, you will play a critical role in helping airlines and airports make smarter decisions, both financially and environmentally.

Leading and coaching a small team of 2–3 business analysts: supporting their development and ensuring the quality and accuracy of their work

Taking ownership of Skailark's supply /technical aerospace  or  finance /cost models

Continuously improving existing models and developing new ones to increase accuracy and value for our customers

Hands-on building and testing of models, working closely with the product team to make sure they fit into the wider Skailark product landscape

Requirements

3+ years of experience in consulting, engineering, finance, economics or analytics

The ability to translate how aviation works in practice into clear model concepts

First experience leading a small team, and the motivation to grow as a people manager who supports and develops others

Either a strong technical and aerospace understanding of aircraft,  or  a strong grasp of financial reporting and airline cost structures

A proactive, collaborative approach and the motivation to see work through to delivery

Hands-on data skills; experience with Alteryx is a plus

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Doctorat Modélisation prédictive de matériaux polymères recyclés par inférence statistique et apprentissage machine hybride.
jobs.description:
Contexte

Le projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingé nierie@Lyon , propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux.

Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique.

Cas d’étude

Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. En instrumentant les étapes de mélange et d’injection, le doctorant cherchera à prédire les propriétés finales de la matière, telles que la viscosité et le comportement des granulés, en fonction des réglages machines. Ce cas offre un terrain d’étude idéal pour tester la résilience des algorithmes face à des conditions de production changeantes.

Profil recherché

Le profil recherché pour cette thèse est celui d’un candidat possédant une double compétence affirmée en intelligence artificielle et en modélisation physique des matériaux. Une maîtrise des outils de programmation et une sensibilité aux problématiques industrielles sont indispensables pour mener à bien les missions de ce projet. Les travaux se dérouleront principalement à l’École Centrale de Lyon, avec des échanges réguliers entre les sites d’Écully, de Villeurbanne et d’Oyonnax, et bénéficieront d’un environnement scientifique de haut niveau dédié à l’innovation dans le domaine des matériaux et des procédés.

Type de contrat  Le contrat sera un CDD de type contrat doctoral ’avec activité (diffusion d’informations scientifiques et/ou expertise)’ géré par Centrale Lyon. La rémunération sera d’approximativement 2035€ net par mois sur 36 mois.  Find  Jobs in France  on Arbeitnow

Drive product adoption and measurable customer value across APJ accounts to support renewals and expansion.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Global team:  We prioritize your talent, not your location.

Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

jobs.title: Staff Design Engineer - Americas
jobs.description:
Hi  I’m

Abhik  ,  Ashby 's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. This role is close to my heart because, as someone who can both design and code, it’s where I’ve always done my best work, but also where I was seen as a rebel and an outsider. I want folks like me to feel at home at Ashby, and so I made Design Engineering a formal role and department that works closely with me. Our first hire was over five years ago, and we’re doubling the team from five to over ten in the next year.

This role truly expects you to design and code. Design Engineer at Ashby isn’t just a Frontend Engineer with new branding, nor is it a Designer vibe coding prototypes. Combining excellence in both is where magic happens. I found that when I put my best effort into both the design and technical implementation of a feature, I had a nimbleness and creativity that was hard to achieve when I did only one or the other. For instance, the UX and UI I envisioned often influenced the data model's design and flexibility, while the understanding of technology's capabilities often simplified or improved the design. This role embraces that.

You’ll work on our most challenging design problems, help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in-house design system, and consult on bespoke design work needed by Product Engineers. To ground it with examples, Design Engineers at Ashby have:

Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using that system to turn the wireframes into a polished UI.

Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build beautiful, consistent setup wizards across our product easily.

Helped a Product Engineer improve the information hierarchy and scannability of their design for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

The Design Engineer role is more common today than five years ago, but I believe Ashby offers a unique opportunity that few can match:

You work on a product at scale, not at an early-stage startup struggling to find users and get feedback on what you’ve designed and built. At Ashby, your work will touch over 100,000 weekly active users, millions of candidates per week, and notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. You’ll get to test out ideas with our own recruiting team and hiring managers who use Ashby every day (like me), and often hear customer feedback as early as the day you release.

This role has always had the commitment of both Benji (CEO & Co-Founder) and me: I’ve held the role, steadfastly championed it since we started hiring in 2020, and haven’t diluted its responsibilities as we’ve grown (in fact, we’ve doubled down).

jobs.description:
Hi , I’m

Abhik  ,  Ashby ’s Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. We’re looking for a great (former) engineer who built impressive products and now builds teams of great engineers. Ashby’s success and ambition mean we’re doubling the Engineering team in the next year, and we need your experience and leadership to do it thoughtfully.

Our product and growth are exceptional. Ashby All-in-One is powerful, easy to use, and replaces several venture-backed companies' worth of products (often with a  better  experience). We have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, growing >100% year over year, very low churn, and many years of runway.

A big part of our secret sauce is how we run Engineering. We achieve incredible speed and quality by discarding many industry norms and being optimistic about Engineers. We consider what makes exceptional Engineers exceptional, figure out how to hire them, and build an environment that gives them the freedom and agency to  actually  be exceptional. In other words, if engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and  not  breaking down projects into individual tickets excites you, you’ve found the right place.

As an Engineering Manager, you’ll work closely with me, Ben, Colin, and your peers to build out the team and continue scaling this unique culture.

You’ll first do that through grassroots leadership. You’ll manage three to five Engineers and hire three to five more. They’ll cover multiple teams and a variety of specializations, from Product Engineers to Site Reliability Engineers to Design Engineers. Your day-to-day will include:

Providing feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.

Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects and deliver them with little intervention.

Jump into our systems and code to debug a customer issue, ship a small bug fix, or improve our developer experience. Engineering leaders at Ashby are great engineers and enjoy keeping their skills up-to-date (while staying off the critical path).

You’ll also propose and lead department and company-wide initiatives. Some examples:

Rethink how we (and the industry) do pull request reviews by aligning on goals with the team, sampling a set of PRs to understand how effective they are, and writing a proposal to the team about what we could change to speed up reviews while giving reviewers the time and space to give useful feedback.

Design and improve interviews based on candidate and team feedback. We pride ourselves on thoughtful interviews that simulate actually working with us!

jobs.title: Engineering Manager - UK
jobs.description:
Hi  I’m

Colin  , Director of Engineering, Europe. How do you feel about software engineers writing product specs, making product decisions, and not breaking down projects into individual tickets? If that sounds exciting (even if a bit scary), read on because I’m looking for an engineering manager to help us build a different type of engineering team and culture at  Ashby .

To start, why do we need to be different? Time and again, I have witnessed engineers knowing what needs to be done yet being unable to get things done because of “the process” or because “more data is needed.” Some of the most effective projects have been  skunkworks  projects, where engineers have taken total ownership of a problem and driven it to completion. I want to normalize that at Ashby.

When we think about how these processes came about, we realize they carry a  pessimistic  mindset. They box people into smaller roles to minimize the chance of not meeting a certain standard. At Ashby. we’re building an environment that is  optimistic  about what engineers can own and achieve and embraces the innovative engineers (and frankly, often stays out of their way).

To accomplish this, our engineering leaders need to think deeply about individual performance, process, and culture - not running sprint planning or driving product and technical decisions. You’ll focus on building your team, their skills to thrive with the ownership they’re given, and an environment that empowers them to do their best work consistently, with little distraction. For junior EMs we try to stay within 6 direct reports. This enables them to spend time with our teams observing, correcting, praising, and, yes, coding. We like our managers to be hands-on while also making sure they’re not on the critical path.

We’ve already gathered an

experienced, talented, and collaborative team

of 25+ engineers. You’ll help me manage the growing team of engineers in Europe.

In addition to working with engineers you’ll also get to work on projects yourselves. Some examples of work our engineering leaders have done:

Provide feedback on product and technical specs to help engineers identify where to cut scope or improve quality. You don’t make the final decisions, but you’ll influence and coach ICs to reach the right ones.

Grow engineers to the point where they can take large, loosely defined projects, and deliver them with little intervention. They still ask for help when needed - the difference is that they’re driving.

Jump into our systems and code to debug a customer issue, ship a small bug fix, or improve our developer experience. Engineering leaders at Ashby are great engineers and enjoy keeping their skills up-to-date (while staying off the critical path).

Improve how we generate and simulate data in demo accounts. It’s a project off the critical path, but it helps you keep up-to-date on our codebase while immensely impacting the business, from Engineering to QA to Sales.

지난 2021년부터 크래프톤은 우리가 가진 게임 제작역량을 새롭게 확장할 수 있는 영역이자 새로운 도전을 지속할 분야로 딥러닝을 제시하고 해당 분야 연구에 집중하고 있으며, 본격화를 위하여 핵심 인재 영입 등 적극적인 투자를 진행하고 있습니다.

[AI Research 본부 비전]
크래프톤 AI Research 본부는 게임과 비게임 분야를 위한 자체 AI 핵심 기술을 연구 개발하여, 기존 사업의 경쟁력을 강화하는 동시에 AI 기술의 사업화를 지원하며 새로운 가치와 혁신을 창출합니다:
  • Multimodal Foundation Model, AI Agent 등 차세대 AI 핵심 기술을 연구·개발하여 게임과 현실 세계에서 사람과 자연스럽게 상호작용하는 지능형 Agent를 구현합니다.
  • AI 기술을 게임 개발과 서비스는 물론 다양한 산업 분야에 적용하여 제작 혁신, 새로운 사용자 경험, AI 기반 서비스와 사업 기회를 창출합니다.

[Culture Fit]
AI Research 본부 인원들은 본인 분야에만 묶여있지 않고 서로 다른 프로젝트 팀원들과 교류 및 협업하여 다양한 문제에 창의적인 아이디어를 제시할 수 있습니다. 다양한 문화적 배경을 가진 인원들이 모여 팀을 이루고 있으며 활발한 소통을 위해 언어적 장벽을 해소해줄 수 있는 방법들을 적극 지원하고 있습니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • MLLM from scratch 개발: Qwen3-VL 등 주요 VLM 아키텍처와 학습 레시피를 분석·재현하고, 자체 LLM을 기반으로 visual alignment → pre-training → physical SFT로 이어지는 3단계 학습 파이프라인을 설계하고 실행
  • Flow-matching 기반 video/action generator 개발
  • World Model 사전학습 연구: 게임 엔진 데이터(PUBG, 인조이 등)와 실환경 데이터를 함께 활용해 도메인에 종속되지 않는 범용 물리 표현을 학습시키는 방법을 연구하고, pixel-space와 latent-space 표현 방식을 비교·검증
  • Task-aware post-training: 완성된 모델을 특정 task에 맞게 post-training하고, RL(ReinFlow 등)과 시뮬레이션 기반 학습을 통해 실제 성능을 검증
  • 평가 체계 구축: Closed-loop 평가 프레임워크와 벤치마크를 설계해 모델 개선 사이클을 빠르게 반복할 수 있는 인프라 구축
  • 대규모 학습 인프라 활용: 대규모 GPU 클러스터 환경에서 분산 학습을 설계하고 실행

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 연구를 주도할 수 있으며 머신러닝/인공지능 논문을 통해 빠르게 이해하고 실험 설계할 수 있는 능력
  • 새로운 domain에 빠르게 적응할 수 있는 분

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

As a Senior Software Engineer on Riot’s Account and Identity Management team you’ll build and operate the persistent account and identity experiences that help players understand, manage, and control their Riot accounts after sign-up. You’ll work on capabilities such as account settings, Riot ID management, account linking, privacy and communication preferences, parental controls, account recovery, and self-service workflows. You will be serving players worldwide and help evolve regional solutions into reusable global capabilities.

You’ll independently drive multi-month projects from discovery and technical design through launch and production support, collaborating with engineers, product partners, Player Support, and teams across Riot. You’ll write secure, reliable, well-tested services and APIs that your team will be accountable for. You will contribute to a strong engineering culture through design reviews, documentation, and mentorship. The ideal candidate brings 3–5 years of software engineering experience or equivalent expertise, experience with backend services and distributed systems, and strong ownership, communication, and technical judgment. Experience with Java or Kotlin, cloud infrastructure, identity systems, OAuth or OpenID Connect, and web security is a plus.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and support our workflow services used by millions of players
  • Support our suite of mission-critical Java, Kotlin, and Node services at a globally distributed scale
  • Partner with product owners and technical leads to build and operate features end-to-end
  • Provide high-quality software by writing unit, functional, and integration tests
  • Invest in team’s complete ownership of our products by participating in on-call rotation

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role (i.e. software, systems, architecture)
  • Expertise in Java, Kotlin, and some familiarity with Node.js

jobs.title: Senior Technical Artist, Animation - Unpublished R&D Product
jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused game development can result in great games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. As the most played video game in the world, over 100 million play every month. Players form the foundation of our community and it’s for them that we continue to evolve and improve the League of Legends experience.

We’re looking for humble but ambitious, razor-sharp professionals who can teach us a thing or two. We promise to return the favor. Like us, you take play seriously; you’re passionate about games. We embrace those who see things differently, aren’t afraid to experiment, and who have a healthy disregard for constraints.

That's where you come in.

在 Riot，技术美术负责搭建和优化美术内容生产的技术基础、工作流程与工具体系，帮助团队以高质量、可持续的方式进行内容创作。他们需要将艺术目标转化为可执行的技术方案，持续优化流程与制作标准，并与多个职能紧密合作，消除制作中的技术阻碍，同时守住内容质量。

作为未公开项目的资深技术美术 - 动画方向，你将专注于动画相关的技术方案设计与引擎落地，帮助团队建立稳定、可扩展的动画技术基础。你将与动画、美术指导、设计、工程以及其他技术美术成员紧密合作，将艺术表现目标转化为可执行的技术实现，并持续提升动画内容在引擎中的质量、稳定性与制作效率。你将汇报给技术美术负责人，并在推进动画技术能力建设的同时，兼顾角色绑定系统的长期发展。

工作职责

  • 负责高优先级引擎动画效果的技术方案设计与落地，包括动画状态机、IK、角色物理及相关动画技术能力建设
  • 跨团队紧密协作，将动作表现、镜头需求及视觉目标转化为可执行的技术方案，并持续提升动画内容的整体表现质量与制作标准。
  • 识别并解决实时动画及动画资产制作过程中的关键技术问题，推进引擎内实现、联调与优化，持续改进动画资产规格，提升落地效率与实现稳定性
  • 搭建、维护并优化角色、生物、道具以及表演相关需求的绑定与动画技术方案
  • 开发和推动面向动画制作与效率工具、调试流程方案，帮助团队更高质量、更高效率地完成内容实现

能力要求

  • 6 年及以上游戏或相关行业技术美术经验，并在技术动画方向有扎实的实操经验
  • 具备从效果目标出发，进行技术抽象与方案判断的能力，能够在动画表现、玩法需求、实现成本与长期可维护性之间做出合理权衡
  • 具备扎实的 Unreal Engine 经验，熟悉蓝图、动画状态机、IK 工作流、角色物理、镜头相关等实现
  • 熟悉 Maya 绑定工作流程与相关功能使用，理解角色绑定与动画系统的基础实现逻辑
  • 优秀的跨职能沟通与协作能力

优先条件

  • 熟悉英雄联盟IP
  • 有主导角色绑定系统开发的经验，或具备基于 Maya 的 Python 脚本开发能力
  • 熟悉风格化角色或变形角色的绑定方案与实现方式
  • 有影视叙事、表演类高规格角色制作流程的相关经验

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

作为申请过程的一部分，我们希望候选人提供作品集或演示demo，并且可能被要求完成艺术测试。

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Product Management, Japan - VALORANT
jobs.description:
As the VALORANT Publishing Lead for Japan, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the publishing strategy of VALORANT in the Japan market. You will bridge global ambition with local execution, ensuring our strategy serves our player base in-market.

As a Senior Manager, Publishing Product Management on VALORANT publishing team, you will lead Riot’s long-term strategy for VALORANT in Japan, scale our publishing efforts and programs across product and esports marketing, community building, influencer management, local channel strategy and partnerships, all while acting as the voice of the Japan region.

Team building and management is a core responsibility of this role and you will have the privilege of leading a team of experienced publishing professionals to contribute to the product’s success. You will report to Regional Publishing Product Lead, VALORANT APAC.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and guide local publishing strategy to ensure our goals, player needs and game health metrics are achieved
  • Lead and grow an experienced publishing team as VALORANT grows with subsequent content releases and player community-facing events
  • Represent and advocate for market and its needs to the global team
  • Implement global brand strategy locally while optimizing owned and earned channels
  • Make key decisions across the region’s communications strategies, audience targeting, performance measurement and integration of community channels
  • Build and scale local partnerships to support the local community and game ecosystem

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in a publishing, business development or product management role
  • 4+ years leading an externally facing program related to experiential marketing
  • 3+ years directly managing an initiative, program, or small team

Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands-on biological research. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be a computational chemist who knows reactions, synthesis, and medicinal chemistry in depth and has hands-on experience training and evaluating machine learning models. Above all, you'll build the reinforcement learning environments, datasets, and evaluations that teach Claude chemistry. jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to build the event-processing pipelines and services that turn Nebius product usage into revenue.
You will work on systems that process a continuous stream of usage events, where correctness and failure recovery matter as much as throughput. The output is money: a silently dropped or double-counted event is a real financial error.
Usage of every Nebius product arrives as a stream of events. Our pipelines and services ingest, validate, enrich and price it in near real time, and deliver the results to invoicing, reporting and customer-facing account management.

In this role, you will:

  • Build stateful streaming pipelines that compute billed consumption in near real time.
  • Develop and operate Go services that ingest usage events, move data between our storage systems and deliver consumption data to users through usage APIs and billing data exports.
  • Guarantee correctness under failures: idempotency, exactly-once processing and reconciliation.
  • Operate transactional storage, persistent queues and change data capture under high throughput.
  • Build reusable streaming infrastructure rather than solving each use case independently.
  • Improve the reliability, scalability, latency and observability of the billing platform.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of your systems: design, implementation, reliability and deployment.

We expect you to have:

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals.
  • Professional experience building and operating backend, streaming or data-intensive systems.
  • The ability to reason about consistency and data correctness under failures.
  • Experience with databases, messaging systems or event-processing platforms.
  • The ability to investigate unfamiliar systems and solve problems without an obvious predefined solution.
  • The ability and willingness to learn the team's technology stack.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with a stateful stream-processing framework such as Apache

jobs.description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs  provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Global Investigator on the triage team, you will be the first line of operational defence in a fast-moving crypto disruption pipeline. You will process inbound complaint data, validate outputs from our artificial-intelligence (AI) investigation platform, and route cases into the investigative pipelines that result in frozen scam proceeds and seized assets. You will hold the disposition pen: your call is what turns a complaint into a freeze, a takedown, a recovery handoff, a legal-process draft, a victim notification, or a close.

The impact you will have:

Validate and route hundreds of complaint dispositions per week, feeding a live asset-recovery pipeline.

Catch the AI errors that matter, such as false positives, merged syndicates, and misclassified scam patterns, before they propagate downstream.

Enrich complaint selectors using a stack of more than forty commercial data-source integrations.

Own clean shift handoffs so the around-the-clock operation never drops a lead, providing EMEA-hours coverage that keeps the queue moving while colleagues in other regions are offline.

What we’re looking for:

Investigative or analytical experience in the private or public sector. One to three years is fine: we want hungry people who want to grow into deep crypto expertise.

Strong AI fluency, meaning comfort using AI tools as a daily co-pilot, plus the judgment to know when they are wrong.

Excitement to deepen blockchain analysis skills.

Comfort operating in a fast-paced, fluid environment where the project's scope and emphasis may shift quarter to quarter.

Strong written and verbal communication.

About the Team:

The team is built around a mix of seasoned investigators and rising talent. Triage investigators sit alongside experienced crypto tracers and intelligence-trained individual contributors, and the seat is designed to accelerate your development.

Team Operating Rhythms:

Daily schedule: standard business hours in your local time zone.

Collaboration: coordinate with global teammates for handoffs on time-sensitive items, giving the wider operation near follow-the-sun coverage.

Formal on-call rotation for high-priority events, such as hacks, law-enforcement support, and other time-sensitive matters.

Weekly rotation, with occasional weekend coverage as needed.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

React quickly to incoming complaint surges and live takedown events.

Continuously learn new patterns in crypto-enabled crime.

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every applicati
