jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Platform Safety builds the infrastructure that lets Anthropic bring its most capable models to more people, safely and securely. Our systems decide both who can access our most advanced models, and what capabilities they can access, wherever Claude is available. That includes identity and business verification, trusted access programs, and the core services that grant, hold and enforce model access across our products. These systems already power the Cyber Verification Program, which now includes Project Glasswing, and the Life Sciences Verification Program with further more advanced use cases in development.

As a Staff+ engineer, you'll help set the technical direction for this work. The foundations are live and adoption is growing quickly, so the next challenge is scale: making access a matter of configuration instead of code, making verification reusable, and giving customers a consistent experience on every surface. You'll work closely with safeguards, product, design and research to turn safety policy into systems that are easy to use and enforce. You'll also take new 0 → 1 efforts from idea to delivery as new capabilities and programs emerge.

What you'll do

You'll design, build and operate the systems that decide who gets access to our most capable models. You'll build the platform that lets teams across Anthropic launch and run trusted access programs, moving access rules out of code and into data so that launching a new model or complex program is simple and scalable. You'll build out our identity and business verification system (KYC/KYB) as a reusable service that any program can use, which means integrating verification vendors, protecting sensitive personal data, expanding into new regions, and building fair review and appeal paths for customers. You'll also evolve the core services behind every access decision, including the services that grant and hold access and the customer and user identity models they rely on, and keep them highly available and consistent across our own products and cloud platforms.

You'll shape the architecture through clear written proposals, review key designs, and mentor engineers on a growing team. You'll also share on-call, lead incident response, and support emerging new programs.

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. jobs.title: Senior or Staff Software Engineer, Inference / Compute Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a Software Engineer to build the systems that treat infrastructure as software. This role owns the software state machines that provision hardware, bring it into service, and manage its full lifecycle — turning racks of GPUs into running inference clusters without a human touching a runbook. The Research and Inference team is your customer: today they file tickets and wait; the target state is that they issue a single API call to stand up, scale, or tear down a cluster, and the system takes care of the rest. The platform is manifest-driven such that teams declare the desired state of a cluster or host — shape, topology, software stack — and the system is responsible for reconciling reality to that manifest, continuously, through every stage of its lifecycle. You will design the engines that manifest the schema, the engines that execute against it, and the workflows that carry a piece of hardware or a cluster from one state to the next—taking it from bare metal to a fully functioning AI cluster for training or inference.

You'll write production code which is typed, tested, versioned, and deployed through CI/CD that models infrastructure state and reconciles it, the same way a Kubernetes controller reconciles a cluster's desired state. Success looks like eliminating manual provisioning work, not documenting it better.

A product mindset - you've built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.You build it, you own it. You are not only responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.

Responsibilities

  • Build the provisioning state machine: design and implement the software that models the full lifecycle of a physical host from discovery, inference bring-up to GPU driver/CUDA stack, health validation, and decommission/RMA — as explicit, versioned states and transitions.
  • Build the self-service API: design declarative APIs and a control plane so the inference team can request, scale, and tear down inference clusters with one API call — no ticket, no human in the loop.
  • Automate self-healing: detect degraded or failed nodes, drain them safely, trigger repair or replacement, and reintroduce healthy capacity into the pool automatically.
  • Own reliability of the pipeline: idempotency, retries, rollback, and drift detection so the provisioning system is as dependable as any other production service.
  • Partner with the inference/ML platform team: understand the cluster shapes they need — topology, interconnect, scheduling constraints — and encode them as first-class abstractions in the platform.

Reporting to your Vertical Group QA Lead of Live Minigames, you will play a vital role in upholding quality standards within one of Monopoly Go’s tightly integrated teams, known as a Pod. jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, VectorDB
jobs.location: New York City, NY | Seattle, WA; San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic is looking for a Staff+ Software Engineer to work on the vector search infrastructure behind Claude. Retrieval is how Claude learns about the world. Web search across claude.ai, the API and agentic surfaces, memory across conversations, and the reinforcement learning workloads that train our next models all depend on fast, cheap, high-recall nearest-neighbor search over billions of vectors.

You'll join a small team responsible for the vector database layer that serves Claude's retrieval workloads: its architecture, performance, scalability and cost. This is a foundational role. The team is small, core architectural decisions are still open, and the engineers who join now will shape how the system evolves.

The role sits in our Databases organization and works day to day with the Search Platform team, which owns web search indexing, retrieval and serving, and the Memory & Search team, which owns search and memory inside claude.ai.

We're looking for someone who has built vector or search systems that ran in production, at scale, with real users and a real on-call. You'll be hands-on in the code, and you'll also be the person deciding how the pieces fit together.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the core of Anthropic's vector database layer: index structures, storage layout, query execution and the serving layer
  • Own production readiness - benchmarking against exact search, capacity planning, onboarding new workloads, and the operational tooling to run it at scale
  • Drive the recall, latency and cost trade-offs - quantization, filtered search, index build and refresh strategy, and how compute and storage are separated and scaled
  • Scale throughput by an order of magnitude as research and training demand grows, and work out whether the bottleneck is architecture, hardware or engineering bandwidth
  • Extend the retrieval stack toward hybrid retrieval - lexical search and fused ranking alongside vector search
  • Set the evaluation methodology for the system - recall targets, latency objectives, cost per query, and the regression detection that keeps them honest
  • Set technical direction for a growing team - lead design reviews, make architectural decisions others build on, and mentor the engineers joining the effort
  • Share the on-call for the systems you own

Minimum qualifications

  • Direct experience building a vector database or approximate nearest-neighbor search system that ran in production at scale

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

We're looking for a senior Tools Programmer to help build the next generation of UI tooling for users and AI-powered agentic workflows (tools that let AI agents assist with and automate UI creation, iteration, and debugging). We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

KRAFTON의 Global HR Planning팀은 빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 해외 자회사 및 법인이 본사의 전략방향성과 Align되어 운영될 수 있도록 HR 전반에 대한 운영을 모니터링하고 Guide하는 팀입니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 해외 파견자 대상 전반적인 운영 지원 (파견 계약, 비자 및 이주, 현지 정착, 관련 행정 업무 등)
  • 해외 파견자 복리후생 운영 지원 (수당, 세금 및 사회보장 등)
  • 해외 법인과의 협업 과정에서 발생하는 Cross border HR 사안에 대한 운영 지원 제공
  • Headcount 관리 및 해외 채용 지원 (인원 현황 관리, 채용 요청 관리, 채용 계획 조율 등)
  • 정기 회의 준비 업무 지원
  • 기타 팀 수명업무 지원

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 학사 학위 이상, MNC 회사에서 인사(HR) 또는 관련 분야 3년 이상 경력
  • 핵심 오피스 툴(MS Office, AI) 활용 능력

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ENGINEERING - GAMES

What We Do

Unreal projects have been leading the pack of real-time entertainment with our constantly growing team of engineering experts. We’re always improving on the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

What You'll Do

We are seeking an experienced Lead Gameplay Programmer to direct gameplay teams within Rocket League. They will be responsible for leading the gameplay programming team and collaborating and iterating with gameplay programmers, game designers, producers, and artists. They will play a critical role in feature development for Rocket League.

In this role, you will

  • Manage a team of seasoned gameplay programmers and be the primary hub of communication and information for other disciplines
  • Distill high-level feature requests into meaningful, actionable work items and delegate effectively to the team
  • Deliver core gameplay features efficiently and on time, and speak up when the team is over- or under-scoped
  • Lead the vision for different gameplay systems and features and write code and do system design as needed
  • Propose and review technical design, systems, and technical approaches to ensure that they satisfy requirements and promote a healthy codebase
  • Work closely with art and design leads to ensure gameplay mechanics meet functional requirements and uphold our high standards
  • Work closely with other programming disciplines to integrate systems in support of the player experience

What we're looking for

  • Experience developing gameplay physics systems (simulation, collision, character/vehicle physics, etc.)
  • Experience with network replication systems (client-server prediction, state synchronization, lag compensation)
  • Proven track record delivering live-service games or AAA MMO titles built on Unreal Engine
  • Proven leadership experience managing high-performing programming teams on shipped AAA titles
  • Strong C++ skills and the ability to code and design gameplay mechanics and tools
  • Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to collaborate and communicate to work cross-functionally and give/receive constructive feedback
  • Experience using AI codin

jobs.title: Sales Enablement Trainer, Claude Products
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Sales Enablement Trainer, Claude Products, you'll teach Anthropic's global sales team how to use our products, both to do their own work better and to position Claude credibly with customers. Anthropic ships quickly, and the surface area of what we build is growing faster than any individual seller can track. The job has two components. The first is enabling our own people to be power users of Claude so the field is the most sophisticated user of the product we sell. The second is enabling them to position it: to run a credible technical conversation with a customer, anticipate the hard questions, and hold their own with a technical buyer.

In this role, you’ll help define what an AI-native sales team looks like. The best person in this role already uses Claude to help them excel in a sales or sales enablement role. You'll be embedded enough with Product and Applied AI to see around the corner and be opinionated enough to say which surfaces to invest enablement resources behind. You'll need enough technical credibility to earn the respect of engineers and enough commercial fluency to earn the respect of sellers.

Key responsibilities

  • Own product enablement for the global field organization, spanning new launches, existing capabilities, and the product roadmap ahead
  • Build the programs that make Anthropic sellers genuinely expert users of Claude in their own daily work
  • Create enablement that equips the field to position our products with technical and business buyers, including demo readiness, objection handling, and competitive framing
  • Partner closely with Product, Product Marketing, and Applied AI to get early visibility into what is shipping and to shape how it reaches the field
  • Anticipate which new product surfaces will require enablement investment, and make the case for that investment before launch
  • Build and maintain the product certification path that credentials sellers on our core products
  • Create high-quality enablement content including demo scripts, technical talk tracks, solution guides, and competitive positioning material
  • Establish feedback loops that carry field and customer signal about product gaps back to Product and Product Marketing

Minimum qualifications

  • Experience in a sales or sales enablement role
  • Experience building AI automations into sales workflows and tooling
  • Hands-on, regular use of AI assistants and agent

jobs.title: Applied AI Demo Engineer
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's customer-facing teams are often the first place a customer sees what Claude can do. As a Demo Engineer, you'll build the demos, reference implementations, and reusable tooling that help those teams make new capabilities tangible, relevant, and trustworthy, ideally within days of a product launch rather than weeks after.

This role sits between product engineering, technical storytelling, and GTM execution. You'll own ambiguous, high-leverage problems end to end: prototyping an agentic experience for a new capability, then hardening it into something reliable that other teams can run on their own. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Internal Comms
jobs.description:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Team

The Twitch community is like no other - a passionate and engaged group of creators and active participants who are uniquely invested in what we’re all building together. The Marketing & Communications team at Twitch serves to authentically activate the Twitch community (and beyond) in ways that inform and inspire. Members of our team work across a range of areas including internal and external communications, content & partnerships, creative services, and marketing strategy.

About the Role

We’re looking for someone to lead internal communications across the company. You’ll help employees understand what’s happening and why it matters, help navigate complex company moments and transitions, and develop company All Hands programming that people look forward to.

It’s a role with range. One day you might be shaping comms for an organizational change; the next, developing a new All Hands segment or finding a great story buried somewhere in the company. We’re looking for someone with excellent judgment, strong instincts, and real creative ambition — someone who runs toward the hard stuff and is always thinking about how to make internal communications more useful, interesting, and engaging. Keeping employees informed and connected, and finding ways to highlight and celebrate our people, our work, and our community, are at the heart of this position.

You can work in New York, NY; San Francisco, CA; Los Angeles, CA; Irvine, CA; or Seattle,WA.

You Will:

Manage Internal Comms

jobs.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a software engineer to build the Kubernetes-native control plane that provisions and runs our GPU inference fleet. You'll design a manifest-driven API where the inference team declares what they need, whether that's a cluster, a model deployment, or a capacity change, and our controllers handle the reconciliation, provider/runtime selection, and lifecycle management underneath, so the inference team never has to know or care which specific serving stack, scheduler, or hardware pool is doing the work. You'll also build the systems that keep the fleet efficient, not just running, including defragmentation and rebalancing logic that consolidates scattered workloads back into contiguous capacity, and scheduling/bin-packing improvements that push GPU utilization up without hurting latency.

The core value we're after is decoupling the people building on top of the platform from the operational and runtime complexity underneath, while squeezing more usable capacity out of the same hardware. You'll build the controllers, reconciliation loops, and self-service surface (API/CLI, not tickets) that make that decoupling real, plus the event-driven health, remediation, and utilization systems that keep it running and efficient without a human in the loop. Strong candidates have hands-on experience with Kubernetes controller/CRD patterns, have built or operated a platform API that abstracts multiple backends behind one interface, understand GPU scheduling and capacity efficiency (fragmentation, bin-packing, right-sizing), and think about GPU infrastructure as software to be engineered.

A product mindset - you've built internal platforms or APIs consumed by other engineering teams and care about the developer experience of what you ship.You build it, you own it. You are not only responsible for delivering the software but also for operating and supporting it in production.

Responsibilities

  • Build the provisioning state machine: design and implement the software that models the full lifecycle of a physical host from discovery, inference bring-up to GPU driver/CUDA stack, health validation, and decommission/RMA — as explicit, versioned states and transitions.
  • Build the self-service API: design declarative APIs and a control plane so the inference team can request, scale, and tear down inference clusters with one API call — no ticket, no human in the loop.
  • Automate self-healing: detect degraded or failed nodes, drain them safely, trigger repair or replacement, and reintroduce healthy capacity into the pool automatically.
  • Own reliability of the pipeline: idempotency, retries, rollback, and drift detection so the provisioning system is as dependable as any other production service.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Designer in Animation
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART

What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Technical Designer in Animation (TDiA) to join our team working across various animation systems. As a TDiA, you will use your animation sense and technical understanding of character animation to design and create gameplay animation systems that facilitate appealing, high-quality character motion. You will be the primary point of contact for animation implementation issues and any animation-related technical challenges, and you will work closely with Animation, Design, and Engineering colleagues to ensure the animation pipeline operates smoothly and efficiently. You will also help identify potential issues and deploy correct solutions, using your technical knowledge to help bridge and facilitate communication between the animation team and other departments.

In this role, you will

  • Create animation behavior tools/techniques/philosophies that allow the building of complex movement systems
  • Design and implement animation state machines/behaviors and runtime solutions
  • Work closely with the Animation, Design, and Engineering departments to analyze, troubleshoot, and solve in-game animation implementation issues and animation-related technical challenges
  • Closely collaborate with the animation leadership to maintain the style and quality bar for animations in the game
  • Look for opportunities to improve the animation pipeline/workflow and help provide solutions for technical animation problems, including performing training and creating documentation for the animation team

What we're looking for

  • A strong animation sense with a clear understanding of realistic and stylized character motion and how to achieve them with modern animation methods
  • Expertise with animation pipelines, including source content creation tools such as Maya, MotionBuilder, and the Unreal Engine, using our Control Rig toolset
  • Exceptional problem-solving ability with strong written communication and teamwork skills

jobs.title: Machine Learning Intern
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - EPIC RESEARCH

What We Do

Epic Research conducts state-of-the-art research in machine learning, AI, character animation, and digital humans. We work with leading universities and product teams to bring new research into games like Fortnite, Unreal Engine, MetaHuman, and the tools creators use every day.

MACHINE LEARNING RESEARCH INTERNSHIP AT EPIC GAMES

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for current PhD students and recent PhD graduates (within 12 months of graduation) for paid research internships, working on state-of-the-art machine learning across our ecosystem. Epic makes Unreal Engine, which powers creative work across many industries, alongside some of the world's most popular games, including Fortnite and Rocket League. Through these products, ML research at Epic reaches millions of creators and players every day. AI is reshaping the games industry, and Epic Research - led by Lucia Specia and Michael Black - is at the center of that shift. We're looking for talented interns who want to be part of it.

In this role, you will

Work with our team of research scientists and programmers at the intersection of vision, language, speech processing, embodied agents, and game development to create state-of-the-art machine learning models in a range of areas - research topics of interest include:

  • AI-backed interactive characters: LLMs for conversational characters, memory systems, automated evals, animation, etc.
  • Game agents: vision-language-action, game-state agents, etc.
  • 3D human and object tracking
  • Reinforcement learning for embodied behavior
  • Speech systems and conversational agents
  • World building and game logic generation: video models, 2D->3D scene building, etc.
  • AI-assisted game development, e.g. the next generation of Epic Developer Assistant for UE and UEFN
  • Embodied and physical intelligence including human-object interaction
  • Multi-modal diffusion models
  • Player safety: AI-alignment, content moderation, etc.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Sandboxing
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Every time Claude runs code, uses a computer, or works as an agent, it does so inside a sandbox. Our Sandboxing team builds the isolation layer behind that work. The same systems run the code Claude writes for users, the environments we train and evaluate models in, and the agents our customers deploy.

These workloads are untrusted by design, and there are a lot of them. Sandboxes need to start in milliseconds, hold up under adversarial code, and scale to a very large number of concurrent sessions. You will work at the boundary between the Linux kernel, virtualization, and the container ecosystem. You will partner with research, product, and security teams to make sure that safe and fast do not trade off against each other.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate the sandboxing infrastructure that runs untrusted, model-generated code and agent workloads at scale

  • Improve sandbox startup time, density, and throughput, including snapshot and restore, checkpointing, and warm pools

  • Strengthen isolation across compute, filesystem, and network, including egress controls and per-session credential handling

  • Investigate and fix performance, reliability, and security issues at the kernel, hypervisor, and container runtime level

  • Build the monitoring, tracing, and debugging tools that show where time and resources go inside a sandbox

  • Work with researchers to support reinforcement learning environments and evaluations that need fast, reproducible, isolated execution

  • Work with product and platform engineers to expose sandboxes as a dependable, well-designed capability for Claude products and customers

  • Partner with security teams to threat-model the platform and to test, harden, and respond to escape and abuse scenarios

  • Work with cloud providers on the hardware and platform features that our workloads depend on

  • Share knowledge on systems programming and Linux internals, and help set technical standards for the team

Minimum qualifications

  • Software engineering experience in Linux systems programming, kernel development, or another low-level area

  • Strong programming skills in at least one systems language such as Rust, C, C++, or Go

  • Working knowledge of virtualization or container isolation technologies such as KVM, QEMU, Firecracker, gVisor, or runc

  • Unde

jobs.title: [HR Div.] Developer Relations Program 운영/지원 (3년 미만 / 계약직)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

KRAFTON은 각기 다른 크리에이티브 아이덴티티와 강점을 가진 약 20개 이상의 글로벌 스튜디오로 구성되어 있으며, 국내에만 14개의 스튜디오가 존재합니다. 다양한 위치에서 다양한 프로젝트를 진행하고 있지만, 우리는 모두 하나의 KRAFTON Family입니다.

KDC (KRAFTON Developers Connect)는 KRAFTON Family가 하나로 모일 수 있는 장으로, 서로 다른 배경과 경험을 가진 사람들이 교류하며 창의성(Creativity)을 더욱 발전시킬 수 있다고 믿습니다.

2011년 전사 차원의 지식 공유와 기술 교류를 목적으로 시작된 KDC는 지난 15년간 유관 업계 종사자, 전 세계 스튜디오 및 파트너들과 지속적으로 교류하며 범 크래프톤 차원의 연결을 확장해 왔습니다. KDC 팀은 KRAFTON의 다양한 신작 개발 및 독립 스튜디오 간의 '연결'을 통해 상호 이해를 증진시키고, 개발자 간 지식과 경험이 활발하게 유통될 수 있도록 커뮤니티를 설계하고 운영하는 역할을 합니다.

이를 위해 KDC 팀은 세미나, 핸즈온 워크숍, 해커톤, 직군별 밋업 등 다양한 형식의 프로그램을 기획·운영합니다. 단순히 보고 듣는 것을 넘어 경험을 공유하고, 인사이트를 얻으며, 의미 있는 네트워크를 형성할 수 있도록 — '인정 → 자극 → 동기부여 → 성장 → 새로운 기회'로 이어지는 크래프톤만의 선순환 개발 문화를 만들어가는 것이 우리의 목표입니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 해커톤 사전 준비 및 현장 운영 지원 (인쇄물 제작, 참여자 관리, 웹앱 데이터 입력, F&B·야간 지원, 설문 분석 등)
  • KDC Week·Club·Track 각 프로그램/행사별 사전 준비 및 현장 운영 지원 (연사 초청·예약 보조, 참가자 관리, 에셋 검수, 등록·세션 운영, 설문 분석 등)
  • 개발 행사 진행 전반의 현장 응대 및 사후 정리 (물품 반납, 사진 아카이빙, 재고·데이터 정리 등)

jobs.title: Principal Engineer Capacity/Compute
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the Role

Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, cpu families and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first-party and third-party compute.

As an engineer on Capacity Engineering, you will build the production systems that power this work: data pipelines that ingest and normalize telemetry from heterogeneous cloud environments, observability tooling that gives the org real-time visibility into fleet health, and performance instrumentation that measures how efficiently every major workload uses the hardware it’s running on. You will be expected to write production-quality code every day, operate alongside Kubernetes-native infrastructure at meaningful scale, and directly influence decisions around one of Anthropic’s largest areas of spend.

You’ll collaborate closely with research engineering, infrastructure, inference, and finance teams. The work requires someone who can move between data engineering, systems engineering, and observability with comfort — and who thrives in a high-autonomy, high-ambiguity environment.

This is a pipeline role feeding four areas. Depending on your background and business priority, you’ll focus primarily in one, but the boundaries are fluid and the problems overlap:

  • Data platform Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Correctness, completeness, and latency are the job, not a footnote. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so it's product work as much as engineering: defining schema contracts, making data discoverable, and figuring out what people actually need.
  • Planning Knowing what the fleet has, where it's going, and what's in the way. Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation. Kubernetes operations on one side, cross-team coordination on the other.
  • Efficiency</

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

2+ years of professional software engineering

Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

Regular use of an AI coding tool

Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

At least 10 hours a week, starting now

A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

Nice to have

Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

Terms

US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you

Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms

The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us

Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

The Security Team of Scopely Explore (formerly known as Niantic) seeks a Cloud Security Engineer to improve the security stance of our infrastructure and production environments. Scopely Explore Engineering leads the development and operation of multiple successful mobile games. We seek creative engineers with excellent technical judgment, strong interpersonal skills, and an eagerness to embrace new technologies. Do you want to be part of our team, and make our internal and user-facing services safer and more robust?

Responsibilities

  • You guide teams making the right security decisions when building out new infrastructure.
  • You build automation to keep our environment safe for our engineers to use.
  • You have an advanced understanding of foundational cloud technologies like Docker, Kubernetes and IAM.
  • You participate in the management of the Cloud Security posture across the organization and multi cloud environments.
  • You own and improve existing infrastructure and tooling for security.
  • You leverage new technologies to elevate Scopely Explore security.
  • You collaborate with the engineering teams on the rollout of security measures.
  • You help shape the security strategy of the company through innovation.

Qualifications

  • You can demonstrate programming skills in one main programming language, as an example Go, Java or Python, this list is not exhaustive.
  • You have 3+ years of experience in a global company with cloud-centric infrastructure.
  • You have an in-depth understanding of Cloud technologies.
  • You have experience building out tooling, helping engineers and improving security.
  • You have proven strong communication and team skills in a distributed environment.
  • You have experience in driving organization wide changes in fast moving environments.

Important notes about this position

  • While being flexible, 3 days weekly presence in the office on a regular basis is expected.
  • The coding requirement is not optional and will be tested during the recruitment process. Coding skills must be sufficient to automate tasks when needed. AI usage is allowed if its output is understood.

jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Washington, DC
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Integrity and Authenticity Policy Manager, you will be responsible for developing, refining, and maintaining policies that prevent the misuse of AI systems for deception, manipulation, and unauthorized monitoring at scale. You will serve as the policy owner for risks related to inauthentic behavior, influence activity, surveillance, and the profiling of individuals and groups, and you will help shape policy frameworks across several areas, including authenticity, information integrity, and privacy and surveillance.

Your initial focus will be on translating the Integrity and Authenticity risk framework into clear, enforceable policies, ensuring policy language addresses emerging threats identified by partner teams, and establishing guidelines that enable consistent enforcement decisions. Many of the most serious harms in this space begin with upstream steps that look routine on their own, such as compiling records about a person, automating account creation, or sorting users by inferred identity. Part of your work will be defining where those steps become prohibited. The role will expand as AI capabilities advance. Safety is core to our mission. You will help ensure our products cannot be used to deceive people at scale, monitor and profile people without their knowledge or consent, or sort and target populations based on sensitive characteristics.

Important context for this role: In this position you may be exposed to and engage with explicit content spanning a range of topics, including those of a sexual, violent, or psychologically disturbing nature, as well as detailed descriptions of privacy violations, surveillance abuses, and deceptive campaigns targeting vulnerable people.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and define policy boundaries for covert monitoring, tracking, and surveillance across different contexts, drawing the distinction between malicious behaviors and compliant dual-use scenarios

  • Write policy guidance on facial recognition, voice cloning, and geolocation inference, specifying which uses require consent and which are prohibited outright

  • Map the surveillance lifecycle, from target selection and data collection through analysis and covert deployment, and define the policy line at each stage so that interventions can occur early in the chain

  • Design and oversee evaluations that measure the model's capability to support social media monitoring, people-finding, pred

jobs.title: Tabletop Exercise Lead, The Anthropic Institute
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About The Anthropic Institute

The Anthropic Institute (TAI) is a function within Anthropic that works to advance the public conversation around AI.

The Institute is comprised of research teams tackling some of AI's most consequential societal challenges: the Frontier Red Team, which stress tests our systems against catastrophic risks; Societal Impacts, which studies how Claude is used by millions of people; Economic Research, which tracks AI's impact on people's jobs and the larger economy; the Rule of Law team, which studies AI's impacts to democracy; and more.

The Institute's mission is to reduce information asymmetries between Anthropic and the outside world, name and answer the hard questions implied by powerful AI systems, and publish these findings so that policymakers, researchers, technology leaders, and the public can reckon with what's here and what's to come.

About the role

The role. You will build and lead the Institute’s tabletop exercise program and the team that runs it. Based on trends visible in the exponential and in consultation with technical experts, you will set the research agenda: which questions the exercises should answer, which scenarios to run, with which audiences, and what each run is meant to test. You will own the methods that make results comparable across runs and turn them into findings people outside the room can use. You will hire and manage a team plus a bench of facilitators, and you will be the program’s public voice.

Why tabletop exercises? If RSI arrives, the hardest problems will be about making decisions under uncertainty. The people making them may not trust each other, and the authorities they work under may not be fit-for-purpose. A tabletop exercise (TTX) allows the people who would face that situation practice it before it is real. It also shows us what tools and information they reach for, including what they would need that does not exist yet.

Tabletop exercises are also a research method. You can run the same scenario many times, with different groups of people (and with many more AI agents playing in silico), and you start to see the distribution of decisions people make. This is one of the few ways to generate empirical evidence about the future, i.e., how people and institutions will respond to situations that have not happened yet.

Key responsibilities

  • Set the program’s research agenda: the questions exercises should answer, the scenarios to run, and the audience for each

jobs.title: Research Intern, Frontier Speculative Decoding (Summer 2027)
jobs.description:
About the Role

The Speculative Decoding team at Together AI builds the draft models and algorithms that let large language models generate faster without changing their outputs. Our speculators run in production on frontier open models such as DeepSeek, Kimi and GLM. Our work sits at the intersection of model training, inference algorithms and serving systems, and we co-design all three to lower the cost and latency of generation.

As a research intern, you will dive into open questions in speculative decoding: new drafter architectures and verification schemes, knowledge distillation and training recipes that align draft and target models, and drafters that adapt as traffic shifts. You will train and fine-tune draft models at scale on dedicated GPU clusters, and test your ideas against realistic serving workloads, including long-context and agentic traffic.

Projects aim to answer important research questions in speculative decoding, enabling faster generation on frontier models, drafters that keep pace with changing workloads, and robust, reproducible evaluation under real traffic.

Past Research

Speculative decoding research by Together researchers, interns and academic collaborators includes:

  • Speculative Speculative Decoding (ICLR 2026)
  • When RL Meets Adaptive Speculative Training: A Unified Training-Serving System (ICML 2026)
  • Beat the Long Tail: Distribution-Aware Speculative Decoding for RL Training (MLSys 2026)

Responsibilities

  • Research and prototype new efficient speculative decoding algorithms and draft model architectures

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Tax team sits within Finance & Accounting and is responsible for the company's tax position as we grow quickly in the US and internationally. New entities and jurisdictions, intercompany arrangements, financing, acquired businesses, and large commercial and compute agreements all carry US international tax consequences, and those consequences are getting larger and more complex as the company scales. We are looking for an International Tax Director to join our Tax planning, M&A, and Policy team. Your core subject matter is the US international provisions, including subpart F, NCTI, FDDEI, BEAT, and the foreign tax credit, along with the subchapter C rules that govern how we form, fund, and structure entities.

This is a hands-on technical role. You will write the memos behind your recommendations, review the models that support them, and see your projects through to implementation, often in areas where the facts are new to the company or the law has recently changed and guidance is still developing. Our M&A tax colleagues lead diligence and deal structure on transactions, and once a deal closes you will help work out how the acquired business fits into our international structure. You will also work closely with the colleagues who own the tax provision, compliance, and transfer pricing, and with Legal, Treasury, and Accounting. If you enjoy carrying hard technical questions through to implementation as part of a small team, we would like to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Lead and support US international tax planning projects from initial analysis through implementation, and contribute to how the planning group identifies and prioritizes its work
  • Analyze the US international tax consequences of business initiatives, including new entities and jurisdictions, intercompany arrangements, funding and repatriation, and cross-border commercial and compute agreements, and recommend how to structure them
  • Perform and review technical analysis under subpart F, NCTI, BEAT, and the foreign tax credit rules, including expense allocation and apportionment and the interaction among these provisions
  • Apply subchapter C to entity formations, contributions, distributions, liquidations, and internal reorganizations, including earnings and profits and stock basis analysis

  • Own the Executive Briefing program at your location: the local calendar, capacity planning, the request and intake process from Sales, and operating SLAs, applied against global criteria and regional allocation
  • Work with regional GTM leadership to decide which strategic accounts receive a briefing each quarter, hold the qualification bar, and proactively surface accounts that should be engaged

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

PROGRAMMING - UNREAL ENGINE

What We Do

Unreal-powered projects have been on the bleeding edge of real-time entertainment for over 20 years. Our team of programming experts are always innovating to improve the tools and technology that empower content developers worldwide.

We're looking for a Principal Al Programmer who builds products that integrate Al into Unreal Engine.   • Partner closely with engine, tools, and backend programmers, and mentor others on both game engine internals and LLM system design

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

  • 모바일에 최적화된 인터페이스와 터치 기반 조작 시스템을 통해 손안에서 펼쳐지는 무한한 모험의 세계를 즐길 수 있도록 설계하려 합니다.
  • 원작의 방대한 오픈월드와 생존, 제작 시스템, 다양한 Pal과 함께하는 즐거움을 유지하면서도, 모바일 환경에 최적화된 플레이로 만들어 나갈 예정입니다.
  • Palworld Mobile에서만 경험할 수 있는 새로운 기능과 콘텐츠로 진일보된 게임 플레이 경험을 선사하고자 합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

  • 커뮤니티 등의 아웃 게임 시스템 디자인
  • 이벤트 시스템
  • 로그인, CDN, 운영툴 연동 등의 서비스 및 운영에 필요한 기능 기획
  • 업적, 퀘스트, 성장 등 기본 시스템 구현 및 개선 작업

이런 경험을 가진 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다! (필수요건)

  • 최소 3년의 관련 게임 기획 경력
  • 원작 팰월드 플레이 경험이 50 시간 이상인 분
  • 기획 의도를 컨셉화하고 능동적으로 제안하며, 이미지/툴/데이터테이블 등으로 시스템 구조를 구체화하는 능력
  • 다양한 구성원들과 피드백을 주고받으며, 성장을 추구하시는 분
  • 모바일 플랫폼을 고려하여 UI/UX 기획이 가능하신 분
  • 해외 출장에 결격 사유가 없는 분

이런 경험들이 있다면 저희가 찾는 그 분입니다! (우대요건)

  • 팰월드 뿐만 아니라 러스트, 언던(모바일) 등의 생존 게임을 100 시간 이상 플레이한 경험
  • 이벤트 및 결제 시스템에 대한 업무 경험

크래프톤의 도전에 함께 하기 위해 아래의 전형 과정이 필요합니다.

  • 서류 전형 > 사전 인터뷰 (Phone Interview) > *과제 전형 > 인성검사 (Personality Assessment) > 직무면접 (Technical Fit Interview) > 종합면접 (2-3회) (Culture Fit Interview) > 합격 및 입사
  • *해당 절차는 각 포지션 및 후보자에 따라 변동이 있을 수 있습니다.
  • 상시 채용으로 채용 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
  • 필요 시, 인터뷰 및 직무 테스트가 추가될 수 있습니다.

This is not a traditional sourcing role. We're looking for someone who was an engineer first and wants to put that technical depth to work finding and winning the best engineers in the market. You'll build and run outreach campaigns, keep pipelines full for specific engineering roles, and bring a steady, systematic hustle to it. jobs.title: Senior Tester II
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

QUALITY ASSURANCE

What We Do

The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a full-time Senior Tester II for our testing group in Brazil. The person in this role will own the testing approach for a specialized domain within a major Epic product, and will be expected to make that domain measurably faster and more reliable to test over time through better methods, tooling, and use of data. You will work embedded with the development team, developing and executing tests with or without QA Analyst guidance, and proactively identifying problems beyond the day-to-day in order to solve them at the root rather than one case at a time. The Senior Tester II is also a technical reference point for the wider test team, mentoring testers and raising the quality bar through example. If you are interested in a fast-paced environment, capable of navigating interpersonal quandaries, and desire to work on a world-class QA team, then we would love to talk to you.

In this role, you will

  • Own the test approach for your area, developing and executing tests independently, with or without QA Analyst guidance
  • Design and introduce sustainable testing methods, including tooling, automation aids, or data analysis, that measurably increase the throughput or efficiency of testing efforts
  • Proactively identify systemic problems that go beyond day-to-day concerns and develop semi-permanent solutions instead of one-off fixes
  • Perform test gap and risk analysis for your domain, using defect data and coverage insights to redirect testing effort to where it matters most
  • Provide the development team with reports on blocking issues, test results, and overall quality status, framing risk in terms the team can act on
  • Escalate quality concerns that cannot be resolved within existing constraints, bringing a recommended path forward
  • Self-prioritize your work on a week-to-week basis and help shape the team's priorities aligned with product goal

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Inference
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic’s Inference organization serves Claude to millions of users and enterprise customers, across our own products and the world’s largest cloud platforms, with the speed, reliability, and efficiency that frontier AI demands. The stack that makes this possible is deep and tightly coupled: accelerator kernels, an in-house inference engine that manages the entire token path for both production and research workloads, distributed routing, autoscaling, and capacity management. Every layer affects the others, often in ways that are hard to see in isolation. We build across GPUs, TPUs, and Trainium, and the complexity of building, testing, and shipping inference software grows with every platform we add.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive the programs that scale it. The work spans four closely coupled areas:

  • Scaling and infrastructure. Routing, autoscaling, and capacity management for the serving fleet, and bringing new capacity online.

  • Velocity. The toolchains, development environments, and CI/CD that let inference engineers build, test, and ship across every accelerator platform.

  • Inference engine. The software between the accelerator kernels and the routing layer that serves every request.

  • Performance. Improving throughput, latency, cost, and reliability across the stack, with correctness treated as part of performance.

This is not a status-tracking role. You'll own outcomes end to end, often where no single team is accountable for the whole picture. Much of your value comes from crossing boundaries into Research, Safeguards, Security, Compute, Infrastructure, API, and our cloud and silicon partners, and bringing back the requirements and dependencies that no team sees from inside its own space. There is little process to inherit, and we want to keep it that way: you'll build the minimum machinery the work needs and remove it when it stops helping. And because this is Anthropic, you'll have Claude as a collaborator. We expect TPMs on this team to push hard on what AI-assisted program management and fleet operations can look like.

jobs.title: [AI Research Div.] Postdoctoral Researcher - LLMs (계약직)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

[AI Research 본부 비전]
크래프톤 AI Research 본부는 사내외 여러 분야와 협업 하여 다양한 문제에 대한 AI 솔루션을 제공하며, 자체 딥러닝 기술 연구를 통해 우리만의 서비스를 개발합니다. 그 방향성은 크게 두가지입니다.
  • 딥러닝 기술 개발을 통한 게임 제작 효율성 및 보편성 증대
  • 유저와 함께 게임 플레이를 할 수 있는 Co-Playable Character (CPC) 개발
[AI Research]
AI Research 팀의 연구는 대규모 언어모델(LLM)의 작동 원리를 깊이 이해하는 데서 출발합니다. 이를 바탕으로 게임 제작 효율화와 새로운 플레이 경험을 가능하게 하는 핵심 기술을 만들어 갑니다. 박사후 연구원이 LLM 연구에 깊이 집중할 수 있는 환경을 갖추고 있습니다.
  • LLM의 표현력·추론·일반화 메커니즘을 이론적·경험적으로 분석하며, 효율성·안정성·성능을 끌어올릴 수 있는 새로운 관점과 알고리즘을 모색합니다.
  • Language Model 기반 Agent 기술을 발전시켜 게임 환경을 스스로 이해하고 유저와 자연스럽게 상호작용하는 Gaming Agent를 구현합니다.
  • 게임을 넘어 Physical AI 영역까지 연구 범위를 확장하며, 인터랙티브 인텔리전스의 다음 단계를 그려나갑니다.
  • Scaling laws, reasoning, tool calling, agentic RL, efficient training, multi-modal grounding, omni-model, world models 등 LLM의 핵심 주제들을 폭넓게 다루고 있습니다.
[Culture Fit]
AI Research 본부 인원들은 다양한 프로젝트를 통하여 여러 분야의 팀원들과 교류하고 협업하며 다양한 문제에 창의적인 아이디어를 제시할 수 있습니다. 나이 및 직급에 관계없이 자유롭게 의견을 개진하는 분위기가 장려됩니다.
다양한 문화적 배경을 가진 인원들이 모여 팀을 이루고 있으며 활발한 소통을 위해 통·번역 등 언어적 장벽을 해소할 수 있는 방법들을 적극 지원하고 있습니다.
AI Research 본부는 연구자가 깊이 있는 탐구에 집중할 수 있는 환경을 지향합니다. 대규모 LLM 학습·실험을 수행할 수 있는 연구 인프라를 갖추고 있으며, 학회 참여·발표 등 외부 연구 활동을 적극 지원합니다. 연구자들이 서로의 전문성을 나누며 함께 성장할 수 있는 환경을 제공합니다.

우리 팀과 함께할 미션을 소개합니다.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.


Art Department 소개

Art Department는 크래프톤 게임 스튜디오의 아트 프로덕션 전반에 필요한 그래픽 기술과 솔루션을 지원하는 조직입니다. 그래픽 기술과 제작 파이프라인을 기반으로, 게임 개발팀이 빠르고 안정적으로 프로젝트를 시작하고 확장할 수 있도록 지원하며, 크래프톤만의 차별화된 아트 기술 서비스를 제공합니다
Art Dept는 “Scale-up the Creative”와 “AI-first”라는 회사 방향성 아래, 장인정신에 기반한 높은 퀄리티, 데이터 기반 최적화, 그리고 제작 효율화를 핵심 가치로 삼고 있습니다.
조직 구성원은 Advanced 그래픽 기술과 최신 트렌드를 선도하며, 전사 스튜디오를 대상으로 최적화된 제작 가이드라인을 제시하는 기술 파트너로서 역할을 수행합니다. 단순한 툴 지원을 넘어, 제작 과정에서 발생하는 기술적 병목을 선제적으로 해결하고, 스튜디오와의 협업(Co-development)을 통해 최상의 개발 경험을 제공합니다.
Art Department는 경험과 신뢰를 바탕으로 국내외 다양한 스튜디오를 지원하며, 지속적으로 성과를 만들어가고 있습니다. 크래프톤 게임이 높은 그래픽 완성도를 갖추고 성공적으로 시장에 출시될 수 있도록, 함께 성장할 전문가를 기다립니다.

Visual R&D 팀을 소개합니다.

Visual R&D 팀은 KRAFTON Art Department 산하 조직으로, 예술적 창의성(Art)과 기술적 구현(Technology)의 시너지를 극대화하는 역할을 수행합니다.
우리는 게임 개발 과정에서 마주하는 다양한 난제를 해결하고, 크래프톤 산하 글로벌 스튜디오들이 최고의 퀄리티를 효율적으로 구현할 수 있도록 최적화된 솔루션과 제작 환경을 제공합니다.
현재 우리는 인게임 캐릭터 제작의 혁신을 목표로 하는 'VCC(Visual R&D Character Customization)' 프로젝트를 비롯하여, 차세대 그래픽 기술 연구와 개발 프로세스 고도화 업무를 주도하고 있습니다.
우리의 목표는 단순한 R&D를 넘어, 실제 프로젝트에 즉시 적용되어 성과를 낼 수 있는 실용적인 기준을 만드는 것입니다.
우리는 지금, 변화하는 개발 환경 속에서 유연한 사고와 협업을 통해 새로운 가치를 창출하고 프로젝트의 완성도를 높여갈 인재를 찾고 있습니다.
각 분야의 전문성을 바탕으로 크래프톤 전사 프로젝트의 성공을 함께 지원하고 성장하고 싶은 분들의 도전을 기다립니다.

jobs.title: [Publishing Platform Div.] Game Security Data Scientist (7년 이상)
jobs.description:
우리는 게이머의 로망을 실현하기 위해, 누구도 가지 않는 길을 갑니다.
예상을 뛰어넘는 과감한 상상력과 기술로, 전 세계 팬들이 잊지 못할 세상을 만들기 위해 담대하게 도전하고 개척합니다.

We pioneer the path to players' dreams.
With bold imagination and breakthrough technology, we create unforgettable worlds for fans across the globe.

우리 팀(프로젝트)을 소개합니다.

KRAFTON 게임의 신뢰할 수 있는 플레이 환경을 만들기 위해 게임 보안 솔루션과 보안 운영 체계를 개발·적용·운영하는 조직입니다. KRAFTON Security Services(이하 KSS)를 중심으로 Anti-Cheat, Anti-Tamper, 보안 운영, 데이터 분석, ML 기반 탐지 등 게임 보안에 필요한 핵심 기능과 서비스를 제공합니다.

KSS는 KRAFTON의 다양한 게임 보안 기술과 운영 역량을 통합한 Game Trust Platform으로, 여러 게임 스튜디오가 빠르고 안정적으로 활용할 수 있는 표준화된 보안 플랫폼으로 발전하고 있습니다.

KSS는 KRAFTON의 다양한 게임 보안 기술과 운영 역량을 통합한 Game Trust Platform으로, 여러 게임 스튜디오가 빠르고 안정적으로 활용할 수 있는 표준화된 보안 플랫폼으로 발전하고 있습니다.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

At Anthropic, we're building AI systems that are safe, beneficial, and transformative. Our mission is to develop AI that benefits humanity, and we believe the most powerful capabilities emerge when we thoughtfully bridge the gap between research breakthroughs and real-world applications.

Frontier AI runs on datacenters, and the world is in the middle of the largest infrastructure buildout in a generation. The binding constraint on progress is increasingly everything around the chips: land, power, permits, equipment, and the design and construction of the buildings themselves. Bringing a single site online involves hundreds of people, thousands of components, and decisions that move enormous amounts of capital. Much of that work still runs on spreadsheets and handoffs.

At Anthropic, we're building software and Claude-powered tools to help Anthropic scale out its compute, and we think there's an enormous opportunity to rethink how that work gets done. It's early, it's already having a real impact, and the engineers who join now will shape how one of the most consequential buildouts in the world gets done.

We're looking for strong, versatile software engineers who love building for people doing real work in the physical world. You'll embed with the teams that source sites, design buildings, procure equipment, and manage construction, learn their work deeply, and build the tools and systems they rely on every day. Datacenter experience is a big plus, but what matters most is that you can earn the trust of expert operators, model a messy domain cleanly, and move fast.

Responsibilities

  • Build the core systems that track a datacenter's lifecycle (sites, designs, bills of materials, equipment, and construction progress) in one trusted, permissioned source of truth
  • Embed with datacenter, energy, and supply chain teams to understand how the work actually gets done, find the critical path, and build the tools they reach for first
  • Bring order to messy data by migrating and reconciling spreadsheets and legacy trackers, and integrate with the industry's tools, like construction management, scheduling, and engineering systems
  • Design for trust: fine-grained permissions, auditability, and data quality for information that steers major investment decisions
  • Ship early, iterate with us

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join our Beneficial Deployments, Life Sciences team. Our goal is for Claude to close the loop on scientific discovery, and a significant part of this is helping Claude to drive scientific hardware and software. You'll help deploy the Model Hardware Standard (MHS) to labs doing the world’s most important research. You’ll scale what you learn in the field by contributing back to the standard, building scalable assets, and driving associated internal product and research direction.

  • Work with labs to automate their experiments end-to-end with Claude - from advising, to prototyping, to writing production code.

  • This role will require significant travel

  • A scientist's instinct for how experiments work: you can spot what's worth automating, and where AI might fail or be unsafe in the physical world.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic’s APAC go-to-market organisation is the fastest-growing part of our international business, spanning markets with distinct languages, cultures and buying styles. Today, enablement for the region is delivered by our global and EMEA teams. As we scale in APAC, we are establishing an initial in-region enablement presence, based in Sydney and supporting the field across the region.

As Enablement Lead, you will be hands-on in getting the APAC field ready: onboarding, ongoing skill development, manager coaching support and launch readiness, across GTM functions, not just sales. You will spend most of your time in the room, running sessions, building programmes and working directly with sellers and managers, in the time zones and languages where customer conversations happen.

This is a build role with a global spine. You inherit a working global and international enablement engine. Your job is to adapt it for APAC, deliver it across the region, and feed what you learn back into the international and global programme.

How we work: adults learn by doing, so we build sessions around live activity: practice, reflection, real customer scenarios. The measure is not what was covered in the room. It is what changes a week later in how people think, decide and sell.

This takes creativity and a solid understanding of how adults learn, applied at speed. The frontier moves quickly and the field is scaling fast. Much of the work is unlearning: helping experienced sellers let go of pre-AI habits, not just teaching new ones. AI is what makes this scalable: endless practice partners, personalised scenarios from real deals, feedback minutes after a call. You will use it that way, not to generate more content.

Key responsibilities

  • Set up the APAC enablement rhythm: in-region onboarding cohorts, live practice-based sessions in APAC time zones, and a feedback loop into the global programme
  • Adapt the international portfolio for APAC, where content for several markets needs to be written and translated ahead of delivery
  • Personally design and facilitate deal walkthroughs, role-plays and customer-conversation rehearsal, favouring practice over presentation
  • Partner with regional GTM leaders to build a coaching standard that scales as the manager layer grows
  • Own launch readiness for the region, so that when a new model or product ships, the APAC field is certified and conversation-ready in the same week cycle as everyone else

jobs.title: Senior Game Designer
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

DESIGN

What We Do

Put your design skills to work at a cutting-edge company that challenges the norm. From character and level design to competitive gameplay and system design, help shape the future of interactive entertainment at Epic.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a Senior Game Designer to help create compelling gameplay experiences across combat, progression, systems, moment-to-moment mechanics, and live gameplay content for our collaboration with LEGO. In this role, you’ll partner closely with design leadership, art, programming, animation, UX, audio, production, and QA to deliver high-quality features from concept through ship. You will own and iterate on gameplay systems, mechanics, and content while balancing player experience, readability, accessibility, engagement, and long-term retention. The ideal candidate is highly collaborative, deeply player-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced cross-disciplinary environment where iteration and feedback are core to development.

In this role, you will

  • Work in close collaboration with project leads & directors to design, prototype, tune, and ship features and systems that support the engagement, gameplay, and creative vision of the project
  • Document and create clear, actionable design documents, and iterate on these features, working with a team of developers across multiple disciplines, and oversee their successful implementation from start to finish
  • Get hands-on creating the scripting, data, and content required by those features, diving into the engine, and leveraging other tools
  • Be responsible for soliciting and rapidly integrating feedback from across the team on your own initiative, ensuring we’re continually delivering a fun and fresh experience to our players
  • Help establish and maintain design pipelines, best practices, and cross-discipline communication standards to scope, prioritize deliverables, and hit milestone goals

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of experience on a live service game, shipping a variety of different features and content types to react to changing player patterns
  • Strong scripting and technical capabilities. Bonus points if you have experience with Unreal Engine and the Ability System

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Anthropic's Beneficial Deployments team accelerates the work of organizations doing some of the world's most important under-resourced work: nonprofits, education institutions, scientific researchers, and organizations advancing economic mobility. Research institutions sit at the center of that mission. They produce the science the rest of the world builds on, and they are structurally short on time, budget, and technical capacity to figure out new technology on their own.

You will lead our targeted approach to research institutes and research intensive universities globally. Where our scaled motion reaches thousands of organizations one to many, this role is the opposite end of the same ecosystem: a deliberately short list of institutions where depth matters, where a lab, a department, or a whole campus adopting Claude changes what science gets done, and where the buying process runs through provosts, research offices, procurement, grant budgets, and security review.

Reach comes first, and commercial results follow from it. That ordering is deliberate and it is shared across every leader on this team: a research institute that adopts Claude to move its science faster is a win on its own terms, and you will be measured on creating that value with the institutions that matter most, not only on pipeline. You are the single accountable owner for the research Enterprise book globally: its target list, its AEs, its numbers, and its field voice inside Anthropic.

You are half seller, half domain translator. You will personally run the most complex institutional deals, and you will be credible in a room of scientists and research leaders. You know how research is funded, how a university decides, and what it takes for a research sales motion to land in a software company. You will bring that knowledge to the product, applied AI, and marketing teams who build for this audience.

This is a player coach seat. You will be directly involved in deals and directing the account executives who cover research institutes and universities today, and the role is expected to grow thoughtfully with more AEs in key regions globally.

Key responsibilities

  • Co-design our global research strategy: the target list of research institutes and research intensive universities that advance scientific discovery.
  • Serve as the lead on our most complex institutional deals — setting the pursuit strategy, opening doors with lab and research-office leadership, university provosts, and person

jobs.title: Staff Applied AI/ML Scientist - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
jobs.description:
Anti-Cheat is Riot’s first defense against cheaters that don’t want to play fair. As a cross-discipline team of former cheaters, kernel developers, machine learning engineers, data analysts, and software engineers, they make products like Vanguard to detect and ban the bad guys across all of Riot’s competitive titles and platforms, staying vigilant to whatever shape they’ll take in response. From beaming bots to scorching scripters, anti-cheat enables Riot’s game teams to take on competitive genres and design rewarding systems that would otherwise be too vulnerable to fraudsters and cheaters. Riot Machine Learning Engineers on Anti-Cheat are builders, trailblazers, and stewards of competitive integrity. We protect the legitimacy of Riot’s multiplayer games and player experience by building automated detection and decisioning systems to address a wide range of anticompetitive threats. As a Staff Applied AI/ML Scientist on Anti-Cheat, you will build machine learning driven detection systems to identify players engaging in cheating and other forms of abuse, and will develop agentic systems for reviewing and and actioning these players. You will partner with anti-cheat experts as well as game product, engineering, and insights teams to ensure that all Riot games afford safe, fair environments for players to compete and thrive. You will report to the Senior Manager of Anti-Cheat Data and Analytics.

Responsibilities:

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6+ years of experience delivering ML systems in production, including 3+ years in applied modeling or ML research roles.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Many of the questions that will shape our future have no single checkable answer. Reasoning well about them, whether in law, policy, philosophy, economics, cognitive science, or AI safety itself, takes the kind of judgment experts spend years building. We believe frontier AI, developed safely, can become a real partner on these questions, but getting there means working closely with the people who know these fields best.

jobs.title: Senior Counsel (Regulatory)
jobs.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

LEGAL

Epic's multi-specialized team of attorneys and legal professionals partner across our organization to provide legal solutions as well as consult and inform on the products we build and games we develop.

Epic’s regulatory team advises the company on newly enacted laws and regulations around the world as well as works alongside our Public Policy Team to monitor regulatory developments.   • Must be able to work proactively, independently, and reliably under tight timeframes in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively with a broad range of individuals and teams
